gem:gruiten.text: Gruiten is a small village in Germany with four hours of its own quiet sights and bigger cities close by. The Rheinturm, Rheinstadion and Konigsallee lie a short ride away. May through September works well, though transport stays poor.

gem:szilvasvarad.text: Szilvasvarad is a village in Hungary set at the edge of the Bukk mountains. Istallos-ko rises right above it, and the Szent Istvan Cave fills out about three hours nearby. Its transport is poor, best May through September by car.

gem:campiglia-marittima.text: Campiglia Marittima is a hill village in Italy, listed among the I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. Palazzo Guelfi and the Parco Archeominerario di San Silvestro anchor about three hours. Populonia sits nearby, best May through August.

gem:szekesfehervar.text: Szekesfehervar is the county seat of Fejer, linked to King Szent Istvan and not far from Budapest. The Szekesfehervar Basilica and Sostoi Stadion anchor about eight hours. May, June and September are best.

gem:camerino.text: Camerino is a small city in the Marche Region of Italy, holder of the Bandiera Arancione quality mark. Camerino Cathedral and the Basilica of Saint Nicholas of Tolentino fill about three hours. May and June suit it best.

gem:cuellar.text: Cuellar is a town in Spain, recognized as a historic grouping around its castle walls. Cuellar Castle and the Puerta de la Juderia lead about six hours of sights. May, June and September suit it best.

gem:detmold.text: Detmold lies among the wooded hills of the Teutoburg Forest in western Germany, home to the Hermannsdenkmal monument. Schloss Detmold and the Externsteine lead about ten hours of sights. June through September is the season.

gem:kleve.text: Kleve, also called Cleves, sits along the Lower Rhine in western Germany, close to Doornenburg Castle and Duivelsberg over the border. Schwanenburg and the Emmerich Rhine Bridge anchor about six hours in town. Best kept to May through September.

gem:patra.text: Patra is a port city in Greece, anchored by the Rio-Antirrio bridge and the Cathedral of Saint Andrew. The Archaeological Museum of Patras and Rio Castle add depth to about nine hours of sights. April and May suit it best.

gem:moulins-le-carbonnel.text: Moulins-le-Carbonnel is a tiny village in France, listed among Les Plus Beaux Villages de France. Perseigne Abbey and the Basilica of Notre-Dame d'Alencon fill about three hours. June through September suits it best.

gem:guardiagrele.text: Guardiagrele is a hill village in Italy, one of the I Borghi piu belli d'Italia, at the edge of Maiella National Park. The Basilica della Madonna del Ponte fills part of about three hours nearby. Best visited in May or June.

gem:ribadavia.text: Ribadavia is a walled town in Galicia, in the northwest of Spain, recognized as a historic grouping. The Castro of San Cibrao de Las and the Monastery of San Salvador de Celanova anchor about three hours. May, June and September suit it best.

gem:limin-khersonisou.text: Limin Khersonisou is a small beach village in Greece, within easy reach of Knossos and Malia. Dikteon Andron and Skotino cave add a further two hours nearby. Its transport is poor, best May through September by car.

gem:aalen.text: Aalen is a city in Germany with about nine hours worth of sights spread across two castles. Schloss Wasseralfingen and Schloss Fachsenfeld lead, with the Jupitergigantensaule von Walheim nearby. June through September is the stretch to plan around.

gem:monte-sant-angelo.text: Monte Sant'Angelo is a hill town in Apulia, part of the I Borghi piu belli d'Italia list, best known for the Sanctuary of Saint Michael the Archangel. Gargano National Park spreads around it, with Siponto nearby. June through August calls for a car.

gem:hanau-am-main.text: Hanau am Main is a city in Germany with about ten hours worth of sights to fill. Schloss Philippsruhe and the Deutsches Goldschmiedehaus lead, with Fechenheim and Rumpenheimer Schloss nearby. Best seen May through September.

gem:aubusson.text: Aubusson is a small village in France, listed among Les Plus Beaux Detours de France. Pont de la Terrade and the Chapelle Notre-Dame de la Borne anchor about three hours. June through September is the season to plan around.

gem:medina-de-rioseco.text: Medina de Rioseco, a historic village in Spain, grew up around its old churches. Iglesia de Santa Maria de Mediavilla and Iglesia de Santiago top the sights, with the old Fabrica de Harina nearby, three hours total. Best in May, June, August or September.

gem:tudela.text: Tudela is a cathedral town in Spain. Tudela Cathedral is the main draw, and Torre Monreal with the Iglesia de la Magdalena rounds out a solid six hours. April, May, September and October make the best window, and getting around is easy.

gem:moss.text: Moss is a coastal town in Norway, with old streets and open water close by. Jeloya comes first among the sights, followed by the Borre mound cemetery, Vansjo and the Royal Norwegian Navy Museum, a full six hours worth. June, July and August suit it best.

gem:loudun.text: Loudun is a market town in France, one of the Plus Beaux Detours de France. Eglise Saint-Pierre du marche and Eglise Sainte-Croix stand out, with the Manoir de Champdoiseau adding a good five hours in all. May through September is the window to aim for.

gem:hamm.text: Hamm is a city in Germany built around an old rail junction. Maximilianpark opens the list, with Burg Mark and the historic Bahnhof Hamm station nearby. Ten hours covers the full day, best May through September.

gem:kloetinge.text: Kloetinge sits in the Netherlands, a village close to open water and old churches. Veerse Meer and the Zeeland Bridge draw the eye first, with Oosterschelde National Park and Oostkerk nearby, four hours all told. June, July and August are the best months.

gem:monflanquin.text: Monflanquin sits in France, one of the Plus Beaux Villages de France. Eglise Saint-Andre anchors the village, while Biron and Bonaguil chateaux make a scenic detour nearby. A couple of hours covers the center, best from May to July or September.

gem:bar-le-duc.text: Bar-le-Duc is a historic town in France, listed among the Plus Beaux Detours de France. The Cadaver Tomb of Rene of Chalon is the standout, with Chateau de Marbeaumont filling out six hours of sights. June through September is the best window to visit.

gem:mala-skala.text: Mala Skala, in Czechia, is a village ringed by castle ruins and hills. Hruby Rohozec castle comes first, with Frydstejn Castle and the peaks of Jested and Kozakov filling four hours. May through September work well, though public transport is thin.

gem:schwelm.text: Schwelm is a small town in Germany, close to the Elberfeld and Barmen districts of Wuppertal. The Nevigeser Wallfahrtsdom is nearby too, and Harkortsee and Bevertalsperre lakes suit an afternoon out. Six hours covers the area, best in June, July or August.

gem:hamar.text: Hamar is a town in Norway on the shore of Mjosa lake. The Cathedral Ruins and Hamar Cathedral anchor the old town, while Vikingskipet and the Railway Museum round out six hours. June and July are the months to come, though transport runs limited.

gem:kastanies.text: Kastanies is a border village in Greece, close to the city of Edirne. The Selimiye Mosque and Edirne Palace are the leading sights nearby, with the Old Mosque and Sherefeli Mosque filling three hours. April and May are the months to come.

gem:saint-fargeau.text: Saint-Fargeau, a village in France, is named among the Petites Cites de Caractere. Its own Chateau de Saint-Fargeau and nearby Guedelon Castle come first, with Lac du Bourdon good for a swim after. A couple of hours covers it, best June through September.

gem:halberstadt.text: Halberstadt is a town in Germany at the edge of the Harz Mountains, thick with old churches. Halberstadt Cathedral is the main draw, with Daneil's Cave and Quedlinburg Abbey nearby filling out six hours. May through September all suit it well.

gem:jerez-de-los-caballeros.text: Jerez de los Caballeros is a historic town in Spain, listed as a Conjunto historico. The Church of San Bartolome and the old town castle come first, with the Plaza de Toros rounding out four hours. May is the month to come, and getting around is easy.

gem:lassay-les-chateaux.text: Lassay-les-Chateaux, a village in France, is named among the Petites Cites de Caractere. The Castle of Lassay and Chateau du Bois Thibault anchor three hours of sights, with the Menhir du Grand Coudray nearby. June through September make the best window.

gem:bergues.text: Bergues, a village in France, is one of the Plus Beaux Detours de France. Its own Tour du Leughenaer comes first, with the Eglise Saint-Eloi in nearby Dunkerque a short trip away, four hours in total. June through September are the months to choose.

gem:grajal-de-campos.text: Grajal de Campos is a tiny village in Spain, listed as a Conjunto historico. Its own castle anchors the sights, three hours or so, with the Monasterio de San Pedro de las Duenas nearby and Sahagun a short trip further. May through September suit it best.

gem:achterberg.text: Achterberg, a village in the Netherlands, sits close to the Utrechtse Heuvelrug National Park. Amerongen Castle and the old Cunerakerk come first, with the Dorestad site nearby, four hours in all. May through August are the best months.

gem:brioude.text: Brioude is a village in France, one of the Plus Beaux Detours de France. The Basilique Saint-Julien is the standout, with the old Pont de Vieille-Brioude rounding out three hours or so. June through September is the window to aim for.

gem:konopiste.text: Konopiste, in Czechia, is a village known for its castle and rose garden. Konopiste Castle and its Rose Garden come first, with Slapy Reservoir nearby for a swim after, four hours all told. May through September work well here.

gem:trelleborg.text: Trelleborg is a coastal town in Sweden, at the southern tip of Skane. The Foteviken Museum and Trelleborgs museum stand out, with the old Dalkopinge kyrka nearby for an afternoon more. Six hours covers it, best June through August.

gem:fossbergom.text: Fossbergom, a village in Norway, sits in the shadow of Glittertind mountain. The Lom Stave Church comes first, with Vagavatnet lake and the ridge of Lomseggje nearby for a short hike. A couple of hours covers the village, best in July alone.

gem:jastarnia.text: Jastarnia is a seaside village in Poland, on the narrow Hel peninsula. Its own Jastarnia Lighthouse is the main draw, with the beach at Cypel Rewski nearby, three hours or so. June through August are the best months.

gem:callantsoog.text: Callantsoog is a small beach village in the Netherlands. The Christoforuskerk and the windmill Zijpe Molen D come first, with Wieringen and Noorderhaaks nearby, three hours all told. June through August is the window to aim for.

gem:vouzela.text: Vouzela is a small area in Portugal, in hill country near the Serra do Caramulo. Viseu itself holds the cathedral and the Grao Vasco National Museum, with the Monastery of Arouca also within reach. Six hours covers a full loop, best in May or June.

gem:zuzemberk.text: Zuzemberk, in Slovenia, is a village known for its castle above the Krka river. Gotna Vas, Ratje and Sela pri Sumberku are nearby hamlets worth a detour, with Dobrnic a little further out, three hours in all. May through August are the best months.

gem:willemstad.text: In the Netherlands, Willemstad is a village on the water at Hollandsch Diep. Its own Grote Kerk comes first, with Tiengemeten nearby and Dordrecht a short trip further, three hours all told. June through September make the best window.

gem:vila-franca-de-xira.text: Vila Franca de Xira sits along the Tagus in Portugal, in the Ribatejo region. The Museu do Neo-Realismo and the Palha Blanco Bullring stand out, with the Tagus Estuary Natural Reserve nearby, about five hours in all. April through June suit it best.

gem:arkhaia-korinthos.text: Arkhaia Korinthos, a village in Greece, is built beside the ruins of Ancient Corinth. Acrocorinth and the site of Diolkos lead the wider sights, with Sicyon and Nemea a bit further out, three hours or so. April and May are the best months.

gem:groede.text: In the Netherlands, Groede is a village close to the coast and the Zwin nature area. Its own Oostkerk and the windmill Hulsters Molen come first, with Walcheren a short trip further, four hours in total. June through August is the window to aim for.

gem:tranebjerg.text: Tranebjerg is the main village on Samso island in Denmark. Kolby and Kyholm are the local sights, with Endelave and Tuno a bit further out to sea, three hours or so. June through August suit it best, though transport stays poor.

gem:warffum.text: Warffum is a village in the Netherlands, near Groningen city. Groningen itself holds the Groninger Museum and St Joseph Cathedral, while Rottumeroog sits further out at sea, four hours total. June through August make the best window.

gem:genarp.text: Genarp, in Sweden, is a village close to the Dalby Soderskog National Park. Lund Cathedral and the ancient site of Uppakra are a short drive away, with Vombsjon lake for a swim in between, four hours all told. June through August are the best months.

gem:fonyod.text: Fonyod is a lakeside village in Hungary, along the south side of Lake Balaton. The hills of Badacsony and Csobanc rise across the water, with the Folly arboretum nearby. A couple of hours covers the village, best in April, May, June or September.

gem:roscoff.text: Roscoff, a village in France, is one of the Petites Cites de Caractere. Its own Station biologique and the Jardin Georges Delaselle come first, with the beach at plage de Groac'h zu nearby, three hours in all. June through September suit it best.

gem:sterzing.text: Sterzing, in Italy, is a village named among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. The Zwolferturm tower and Jochlsthurn stand out, with Obernberger See lake nearby, four hours or so. June through August are the best months.

gem:monte-argentario.text: Monte Argentario is a coastal town in Italy, named among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. The Concattedrale di Santa Maria Assunta comes first, with the lagoon at Laguna di Orbetello filling out five hours. May through July is the window to aim for.

gem:nyons.text: Nyons, a village in France, is one of the Plus Beaux Detours de France. The Pont Roman leads the sights, with Tour Randonne and the ruins of the Chateau delphinal close behind, three hours all told. May and June are the best months.

gem:capalbio.text: Capalbio, in Italy, is a village named among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. The Giardino dei Tarocchi comes first, with Chiesa di San Nicola nearby, and Lago di Burano good for a swim after, three hours in total. May through August suit it best.

gem:garessio.text: Garessio, a village, holds a place among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. Monte Spinarda and Monte Galero lead the sights, worth three hours, and June through August works best. Public transport is poor.

gem:saint-renan.text: Saint-Renan, a village, holds a place among Les Plus Beaux Detours de France. Fort du Questel and Fort Montbarey anchor a three hour visit, with plage du Moulin-Blanc and Le Minou nearby. Public transport is good, best June through September.

gem:stilo.text: Stilo, a village, ranks among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia and the UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List. Monte Consolino and the Eremo di Santa Maria della Stella top the sights, about three hours. The best months run May through August.

gem:saint-jean-de-maurienne.text: Saint-Jean-de-Maurienne, a town, ranks among Les Plus Beaux Detours de France. Its cathedral and the Tour du Chatel come first, five hours needed, with Aiguille de Peclet rising nearby. June through September works best.

gem:citta-sant-angelo.text: Citta Sant'Angelo, a village, counts among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. Sant'Agostino and the Chiesa e Chiostro di San Francesco come first, two hours covers it. The best months are May, June and September.

gem:casale-marittimo.text: Casale Marittimo, a village in Italy, centers on Bolgheri and the Viale dei Cipressi, with San Vincenzino and the Chiesa di Sant'Andrea close behind, three hours to spare. May or June is best.

gem:campli.text: Campli, a village in Italy, is anchored by Montagna dei Fiori and the Osservatorio astronomico di Collurania, four hours well spent. The best months are May and June, and public transport is poor.

gem:treguier.text: Treguier, a village, counts among Petites Cites de Caractere. Its cathedral and the Chapelle Saint-Gonery lead, with the Jardins de Kerdalo close behind, about three hours, best July through September.

gem:lugnano-in-teverina.text: Lugnano in Teverina, a village, appears among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. Santa Maria Assunta and the Castello di Alviano head the list, three hours does it, with Lake Alviano nearby. Its best months are May, June and September.

gem:sutera.text: Sutera, a village in Italy, is built around the Castello Manfredonico, Monte Conca and the Ponte Romano di Campofranco, two hours does the job. May or June works best, though public transport is limited.

gem:crecchio.text: Crecchio, a village, is one of I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. The Museo dell'Abruzzo Bizantino ed Altomedievale and the Castello di Crecchio lead, plan on three hours. The best months run May through August.

gem:monteleone-di-spoleto.text: Monteleone di Spoleto, a village in Italy, draws on the Basilica di Santa Rita da Cascia and Dogana Salto del Cieco, three hours in all. June through August works best, and public transport is poor.

gem:anversa-degli-abruzzi.text: Anversa degli Abruzzi, a village, sits among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. The Eremo di San Domenico and Rocca di Villalago lead, about three hours, with Lago di Scanno and Lago di San Domenico close by. May or June is best.

gem:castel-di-tora.text: Castel di Tora, a village in Italy, is known for Trebula Mutuesca, Monte Cervia and the Santuario di Santa Vittoria, two hours to spare, with Lago del Salto nearby. The best months are May and June.

gem:diano-castello.text: Diano Castello, a village, figures among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. The castello di Cervo, Giardino Villa Grock and the Santuario di Nostra Signora della Rovere lead the sights, four hours to spare, best May through September.

gem:ainhoa.text: Ainhoa, a village, is one of Les Plus Beaux Villages de France. The Grottes de Sare and the Cueva de Alkerdi head the list, three hours covers it, with Larrun and Artzamendi rising nearby, best June to September.

gem:treia.text: Treia, a village in Italy, centers on the Accademia Georgica, the Castello di Pitino and the Cattedrale Santissima Annunziata, with Lake Cingoli close by, two hours does it. May or June works best.

gem:quintin.text: Quintin, a village, appears among Petites Cites de Caractere, centered on the Chateau de Quintin. The Menhir de la Roche Longue stands nearby, with Lac de Bosmeleac close by, about three hours. June through September works best.

gem:navelli.text: Navelli, a village in Italy, is anchored by Aufinum, the Oratorio di San Pellegrino and the Chiesa di Santa Maria Assunta, three hours is enough. The best months are May and June, and public transport is poor.

gem:moncontour.text: Moncontour, a village, sits among Les Plus Beaux Villages de France. The Allee couverte du Champ-Grosset, St-Mathurin and the Hotel de Clezieux lead, give it three hours, best June through September.

gem:belcastel.text: Belcastel, a village, figures among Les Plus Beaux Villages de France. The chateau de Belcastel and the Vieux Pont de Belcastel come first, three hours does it, best June to September. Public transport is poor.

gem:curemonte.text: Curemonte, a village, stands among Les Plus Beaux Villages de France. The chateau de Cavagnac and the Chateau de la Johannie lead, about three hours. Its best months run May through September.

gem:blesle.text: Blesle, a village, holds a place among Les Plus Beaux Villages de France. The Eglise Saint-Pierre de Blesle and the Chateau de Leotoing top the sights, plan on three hours. June through September works best.

gem:vals-les-bains.text: Vals-les-Bains, a village, ranks among Les Plus Beaux Detours de France. The Chateau d'Aubenas, the Chateau de Boulogne and the Grange du Cheylard lead the sights, three hours to spare. May or June is best.

gem:pradelles.text: Pradelles, a village in France, is built around the Filature des Calquieres and the Eglise Saint-Paul de Saint-Paul-de-Tartas, with Lac d'Issarles and Lac du Bouchet nearby, roughly three hours, best June through August.

gem:becherel.text: Becherel, a village, counts among Petites Cites de Caractere. The Chateau de Hac and the Chateau de Caradeuc lead, with the Alignements de Lampouy and Chateau de Montmuran nearby. The best months run June through September.

gem:essoyes.text: Essoyes, a village, appears among Petites Cites de Caractere. The Chateau de Chacenay and the Eglise Saint-Victor de Chervey lead the sights, with the Chapelle de Servigny nearby, two hours enough, best June to September.

gem:sammichele-di-bari.text: Sammichele di Bari, a village, stands among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. The Parco archeologico di Monte Sannace and Monte Sannace itself lead, two hours covers it. The best months are May and June.

gem:saint-robert.text: Saint-Robert, a village, is one of Les Plus Beaux Villages de France. The Abbaye de Dalon and the Chateau de Badefols top the sights, give it three hours. June through September works best, and public transport is poor.

gem:uzerche.text: Uzerche, a village, sits among Les Plus Beaux Detours de France. The Abbaye Saint-Pierre d'Uzerche, the Maison de Tayac and the Eglise Saint-Pierre lead, two hours to spare, best June through September.

gem:plombieres-les-bains.text: Plombieres-les-Bains, a village, figures among Les Plus Beaux Detours de France. The Bain Stanislas, the Thermes Napoleon and the Cascade de Faymont head the list, plan on three hours, best June to September.

gem:saint-aubin-du-cormier.text: Saint-Aubin-du-Cormier, a village, stands among Petites Cites de Caractere. The Chateau de Saint-Aubin-du-Cormier and the Menhir de la Baudouinais lead, about three hours. The best months run June through September.

gem:mussy-sur-seine.text: Mussy-sur-Seine, a village, holds a place among Petites Cites de Caractere. The Vix Grave and the Eglise Saint-Pierre de Mussy-sur-Seine come first, three hours does the job. June through September works best.

gem:airvault.text: Airvault, a village, ranks among Petites Cites de Caractere. The Chateau d'Airvault, Pont du Vernay and the Abbatiale Saint-Jouin de Marnes top the sights, roughly three hours, best May through September.

gem:le-monastier-sur-gazeille.text: Le Monastier-sur-Gazeille, a village, counts among Petites Cites de Caractere. The Chateau de Beaufort and the Viaduc de la Recoumene lead, with Lac d'Issarles and Lac du Bouchet nearby, three hours to spare, best June to August.

gem:capdenac.text: Capdenac, a village, appears among Les Plus Beaux Villages de France. The Champollion Museum and the chapelle Saint-Clair de Causse-et-Diege top the sights, three hours covers it. The best months run May through September.

gem:usson.text: Usson, a village, is one of Les Plus Beaux Villages de France. The Abbatiale Saint-Austremoine and the Eglise Saint-Julien de Bansat lead, give it three hours, best June through September. Public transport is poor.

gem:autoire.text: Autoire, a village in France, draws on Padirac and the Chateau de Castelnau-Bretenoux, with Lac du Tolerme nearby, about three hours. May through September works best, and public transport is poor.

gem:saint-galmier.text: Saint-Galmier, a village, sits among Les Plus Beaux Detours de France. The Chateau de Montrond, the Chateau de Boutheon, the hat museum and the Eglise Saint-Galmier lead, two hours does it, best May to September.

gem:charlieu.text: Charlieu, a village, figures among Les Plus Beaux Detours de France. The Abbaye de Charlieu and the Eglise Saint-Philibert de Charlieu top the sights, three hours to spare, best May through September.

gem:larressingle.text: Larressingle is a fortified village in France, one of the Les Plus Beaux Villages de France. Condom Cathedral and the Abbaye de Flaran lead its sights, worth about three hours, best May, June or September.

gem:fources.text: Fources is a historic village in France, also listed among the Les Plus Beaux Villages de France. Eglise Saint-Jean de Villeneuve-de-Mezin leads several small churches that take about three hours, best kept to May, June or September.

gem:chateauvillain.text: Chateauvillain is a historic village in France, recognized as one of the Petites Cites de Caractere. The Chateau de Dinteville and the ruined Saint James Gate anchor a visit of about two hours, best between June and September.

gem:semur-en-brionnais.text: Semur-en-Brionnais is a small village in France, part of the Les Plus Beaux Villages de France. Eglise Saint-Hilaire de Semur-en-Brionnais and the Chateau de Semur-en-Brionnais fill about three hours, best June through September.

gem:rieux-volvestre.text: Rieux-Volvestre is an old village in France listed among the Les Plus Beaux Detours de France. Rieux Cathedral leads the sights, with about three hours needed, best in May, June or September.

gem:le-broc.text: Le Broc is a small village in France and one of the Petites Cites de Caractere. Puy de Mercoeur and the Chateau de Villeneuve-Lembron top four hours of sightseeing, best from June to September.

gem:saint-aulaye.text: Saint-Aulaye is a quiet village in France among the Petites Cites de Caractere. The Eglise monolithe Saint-Jean and the Chateau d'Aubeterre-sur-Dronne, both at Aubeterre-sur-Dronne, fill a good three hours, in season from May to September.

gem:saint-loup-lamaire.text: Saint-Loup-Lamaire is a historic village in France that belongs to the Petites Cites de Caractere network. The Chateau d'Airvault leads three more chateaux nearby, filling roughly three hours, best any month from May to September.

gem:oingt.text: Oingt is an old village in France within the Les Plus Beaux Villages de France. The Chateau du Sou leads three more chateaux and the Eglise Saint-Eloi de Liergues, close to three hours in all, best June through September.

gem:sandwich.text: Sandwich is a United Kingdom market town, its old streets close to Richborough Castle and Ramsgate. St Augustine's Cross and St Clement's Church round out about four hours, best in July or August.

gem:wetherby.text: Wetherby is a United Kingdom market town, with Spofforth Castle and Bramham Park among its draws. Collingham Bridge and the Marston Moor battle site add to a full six hours, best across June, July and August.

gem:tonbridge.text: Tonbridge is a market town in the United Kingdom built around Tonbridge Castle. Penshurst Place and Ightham Mote extend a visit to about six hours, best from June through September.

gem:saint-antoine-l-abbaye.text: Saint-Antoine-l'Abbaye, a village in France among the Les Plus Beaux Villages de France, grew up around the Abbey of Saint-Antoine-l'Abbaye. The Chateau de l'Arthaudiere rounds out a three-hour visit, best from May to September.

gem:whitchurch.text: Whitchurch is a market town in the United Kingdom near Combermere Abbey and Iscoyd Park. Churton Memorial Fountain and The Gelli round out the five hours needed, best kept to June, July or August.

gem:rayleigh.text: Rayleigh is a market town in the United Kingdom, with Hadleigh Castle and Rochford Hall among the highlights. Six hours suits the sights, best from June to September, and Mill Beach lies nearby for a break.

gem:wendover.text: Wendover is a small village in the United Kingdom close to Chequers and Halton House. Tring Park Mansion and Whiteleaf Cross round out about four hours, best June through September, with good transport links.

gem:ellesmere.text: Ellesmere is a quiet village in the United Kingdom built around Whittington Castle and Halston Hall. St Mary, St Michael and All Angels caps a three-hour visit, best in June, July or August.

gem:populonia.text: Populonia is a small town in Italy, listed among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. The Museo archeologico del territorio di Populonia and the nearby Cittadella di Piombino fill most of six hours, with Calamoresca beach close by, best May through July.

gem:hucknall.text: Hucknall is a United Kingdom town, home to Newstead Abbey and the Bennerley Viaduct. Papplewick Hall and Sir John Robinson's Almshouses round out six hours, best across June, July and August.

gem:castle-cary.text: Castle Cary is a historic village in the United Kingdom centered on Gants Mill and Sexey's Hospital. Bow Bridge and North Cadbury Court fill out four unhurried hours, best from June to September.

gem:middleham.text: Middleham is a small village in the United Kingdom built around Middleham Castle. Jervaulx Abbey and Coverham Abbey nearby round out close to three hours, best in June, July or August.

gem:san-giovanni-di-fassa.text: San Giovanni di Fassa sits in Val di Fassa in Italy, among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. The Vajolet Towers and views toward Marmolada and Sassolungo fill a three-hour visit, best June through August.

gem:bruton.text: Bruton is an old village in the United Kingdom known for King Alfred's Tower and Cary Castle. Bow Bridge and Sexey's Hospital extend the visit past four hours, best June to September.

gem:masham.text: Masham is a quiet village in the United Kingdom near Jervaulx Abbey and Snape Castle. Marmion Tower and Swinton Park keep the visit to about three hours, best in June, July or August.

gem:bulwell.text: Bulwell is a United Kingdom town on the edge of Nottingham. The Nottingham Castle Museum and Art Gallery and Newstead Abbey lie nearby, worth six unhurried hours, best June through August.

gem:nuragus.text: Nuragus is a small village in Italy with its own Menhir Museum and the Nuraghe Is Paras site. The Su Nuraxi complex and Giara di Gesturi are a short trip away, and three hours covers it all, best in May, June or September.

gem:setzu.text: Setzu is a tiny village in Italy with just 166 residents. Su Nuraxi and the Giara di Gesturi are nearby, and Castello di Las Plassas fills out the last of three hours, best in April or May.

gem:turri.text: Turri, a village in Italy of about 436 people, sits close to Su Nuraxi and the Giara di Gesturi. Castello di Las Plassas and the Tomba di Giganti - Sa domu 'e s'orcu are worth folding in, three hours in total, best April or May.

gem:villanovafranca.text: Villanovafranca counts about 1416 people in Italy, a village near su Mulinu and Gutturu Caddi. The well-known Su Nuraxi sits nearby too, about three hours in all, best in May or September.

gem:genuri.text: Genuri is a small village in Italy centered on the Cattedrale dei Santi Pietro e Paolo. Su Nuraxi and the Giara di Gesturi lie a short drive off, and three hours covers Genuri itself, best April, May or September.

gem:pauli-arbarei.text: Pauli Arbarei is a small village in Italy, home to about 611 people, next to the Nuraghe Genna Maria site. Su Mulinu and Su Nuraxi both lie within reach, three hours between them, best in April or May.

gem:borgo-san-lorenzo.text: Borgo San Lorenzo is a town in Italy near the Villa medicea di Cafaggiolo and Villa medicea del Trebbio. The Palazzo dei Vicari and Lago di Bilancino round out six unhurried hours, best in May, June or September.

gem:castel-del-monte-it.text: Castel del Monte is a modest village in Italy, one of I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. Monastero di Santa Maria delle Grazie anchors the village itself, with the Castello di Rocca Calascio nearby, together about three hours, best June through August.

gem:lliria.text: Lliria is a city in Spain and part of the UNESCO Creative Cities Network, with a population near 22972. Edeta and the Torre del Virrei lead a six-hour day of sightseeing, best in April or May.

gem:klirou.text: Klirou is a small village in Cyprus on the UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List. Malounta and Fikardou sit close by, and the nearby Tamassos ruins and Machairas Monastery make for about two hours, best in April or May.

MPL.text: Montpellier is a city in France with a coastline nearby at Espiguette beach. The Musee Fabre and Montpellier Cathedral anchor a full ten-hour day of sightseeing, best in May or June.

GLA.text: Glasgow, a United Kingdom city, is part of the UNESCO Creative Cities Network. Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum and Glasgow Cathedral lead a full day of sights, close to seventeen hours in all, best from June to August.

LPL.text: Liverpool is a United Kingdom city recognized by the UNESCO Creative Cities Network. Liverpool Cathedral and the Metropolitan Cathedral of Christ the King lead a long day of sights, with Crosby Beach for a coastal break, best June through August.

BSL.text: Basel is a city in Switzerland known for the Kunstmuseum Basel and the Fondation Beyeler. Vitra Design Museum sits just across the border, and a full day, about ten hours, covers the art scene, best May through September.

OSL.text: Oslo is a city in Norway centered on Akershus fortress and the Oslo Opera House. The Viking Ship Museum and Bislett Stadium extend a visit toward seventeen hours, with Huk beach nearby, best June or July.

TRF.text: Oslo pairs the Viking Ship Museum and Akershus fortress with the modern Oslo Opera House, all connected by excellent transport. The sights take about seventeen hours, best in June or July, with the lakes Tyrifjorden and Oyeren a short trip beyond the city.

SOF.text: Sofia sits below Vitosha mountain in Bulgaria, its skyline mixing the domes of Alexander Nevsky Cathedral with the golden minaret of Banya Bashi Mosque. Its historic core takes about seventeen hours, best covered in May, June or September.

gem:alberobello.text: Alberobello, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Italy, is known for the trulli houses filling its old quarter. Castellana Caves and Trullo Sovrano round out a visit of about four hours, ideal in June, July or August.

gem:nazare.text: On the coast of Portugal, Nazare is known for its surf beaches, including Praia do Norte. The Alcobaca Monastery and the Sanctuary of Our Lady of Nazare fill out a day of about five hours, best planned for June, July or August.

gem:torshavn.text: Torshavn is the small capital of the Faroe Islands, ringed by the outer islets of Koltur, Hestur and Nolsoy. Torshavn Cathedral and the Nordic House anchor a visit of about five hours, best made June through August since public transport stays poor.

gem:tavira.text: Tavira is a quiet river town on the Algarve coast of Portugal, its Castelo de Tavira looking out over the Ria Formosa Nature Park. Six hours covers the old streets and the Praia de Cacela Velha nearby, best from May through September.

gem:blagaj.text: Blagaj, a village in Bosnia and Herzegovina, is built where a spring feeds Vrelo Bune below the cliffside Blagaj Fortress. Karadzozbey Mosque rounds out a two hour stop, with Stari Most in nearby Mostar an easy add-on from May to September.

gem:sveti-stefan.text: Sveti Stefan, an island town on the coast of Montenegro, is now run as a luxury retreat within sight of Lovcen and the Bay of Kotor. Jaz Beach and the historic Region of Kotor make easy day trips, with six hours or so needed, best timed for May or June.

gem:ypres.text: Ypres, a memorial town in Belgium, is centered on the history of the First Battle of Ypres, its Menin Gate and the museum In Flanders Fields marking that past. A visit runs roughly six hours, best made June through September on good public transport.

gem:viana-do-castelo.text: Viana do Castelo is a historic port town on the coast of Portugal, its Elevador de Santa Luzia carrying visitors up to the old ruins above the city. Ponte Eiffel and Forte de Santiago da Barra round out about six hours, best planned for June, July or August.

gem:marstrand.text: Marstrand, a sailing island off the coast of Sweden, has an old town climbing up to the cannons of Carlsten Fortress. Tjorn and Hisingen add boat trips to about seven hours in all, best from June through August.

gem:sopron.text: Sopron is a medieval wine town in Hungary near the Austrian border, its Old Synagogue and the ruins of the Fertorakos mithraeum both worth a stop. The sights add up to about nine hours, best split across May through September.

gem:esztergom.text: Esztergom sits on the Danube in Hungary, its hilltop Primatial Basilica visible for miles around. Esztergom Castle and the Maria Valeria Bridge across the river round out about six hours, best planned for April, May, June or September.

gem:ostrog-monastery.text: Ostrog Monastery is a mountainside pilgrimage site in central Montenegro, its white walls set into the cliff face above the valley. The terraces and chapels take about four hours to see, best visited June through August, below the peak of Bobotov Kuk.

gem:villers-abbey.text: Villers Abbey, a historic town in Belgium, takes its name from battle history that also touches nearby Quatre Bras. Sombreffe Castle, the Lion's Mound and Grotte de Spy make an easy loop of six hours or so, ideal anytime from May to September.

gem:hallerbos.text: Hallerbos, a town in Belgium surrounded by countryside good for hiking, lies within reach of the Battle of Waterloo site and the Victor Horta town houses nearby. A relaxed visit takes close to six hours, best planned for June through September.

gem:terschelling.text: Terschelling is a quiet island in the Netherlands, part of the West Frisian Islands chain, with the Brandaris lighthouse marking its main village. The dunes of Vliehors and the beach trails fill about six hours, best walked June through August.

gem:schiermonnikoog.text: Schiermonnikoog is a remote island in the Netherlands, almost entirely covered by Schiermonnikoog National Park. Rottumeroog and Rottumerplaat lie further out for more time, with about seven hours needed here, best June through August.

gem:veere.text: Veere, a harbor village on the coast of the Netherlands, has an old quay looking out over the Veerse Meer. Middelburg Abbey and the Walcheren countryside make easy add-ons to about four hours here, best planned for June, July or August.

gem:ebeltoft.text: Ebeltoft is a small harbor town in Denmark, home to the preserved ship Fregatten Jylland and the glass collections of Glasmuseet Ebeltoft. The town itself takes about three hours, with Nationalpark Mols Bjerge nearby for a hike in June, July or August.

gem:jested.text: Jested is a mountain in Czechia topped by the distinctive Jested Tower, visible for miles above Liberec Town Hall in the valley below. The summit trails and ski jumping hills take about seven hours, best hiked June through August.

gem:lipica.text: Lipica Stud Farm sits in the karst countryside of Slovenia, within easy reach of the Skocjan Caves and the small towns of Sezana and Divaca. A quiet family day here runs about seven hours, best from June through August.

gem:moravian-karst.text: Moravian Karst is a cave studded region of Czechia south of Brno, its underground rivers running through the Byci skala Cave. Spilberk Castle and Villa Tugendhat add architecture to about seven hours of exploring, best planned for June through September.

gem:trebon.text: Trebon is a small spa town in Czechia, its Trebonsky zamek castle looking over the nearby Sovi les woods. Branske doubi and the Vlkovska piskovna lake round out about six hours, best spread across May through September given the poor local transport.

gem:low-tatras.text: Low Tatras is a mountain range in Slovakia built for hiking and skiing, its trails climbing from Demanovska dolina up toward the peak of Chopok. The Demanovska Cave of Liberty adds an underground stop to about six hours, best kept to July or August.

gem:skofja-loka.text: Skofja Loka is a medieval town in central Slovenia, its old core spreading below Stara Loka and the wooded hills toward Krizna Gora. The town and a walk to the Gozdni rezervat Zminec reserve take about six hours, easiest May through August.

gem:walchensee.text: Walchensee is an alpine lake in Germany ringed by Zugspitze and Alpspitze, with the Herzogstand trail climbing straight from its shore. Ettal Abbey and the Walchenseekraftwerk power station fill out about seven hours, best hiked June through August.

gem:spreewald-lubbenau.text: Spreewald is a small town in Germany centered on Lubbenau, its Spreewaldmuseum and the reconstructed Slawenburg Raddusch fort tracing local history. The town takes about six hours to see, best planned for May through September.

gem:monschau.text: Monschau is a small half timbered town in the German Eifel, its hilltop Burg Monschau looking down over narrow lanes toward the Hurtgen Forest. Six hours covers the old town and a walk toward the High Fens, best from June through August.

gem:bernkastel-kues.text: Bernkastel-Kues is a wine village in Germany, its Graacher Tor gate opening onto steep vineyard slopes below Burg Landshut. Schloss Veldenz and Schloss Lieser extend the visit beyond the four hours the village itself needs, best May through September.

gem:engelberg.text: Engelberg is a small alpine village in Switzerland below the summit of Titlis, with trails climbing past Obermatt toward the ridge. Reichenbach Falls and the peak of Pilatus fill out about four hours, best timed for June through August.

gem:grasse.text: Grasse is a hillside town in France long tied to the perfume trade, its Grasse Cathedral and the Palais des Festivals et des Congres anchoring the old center. Villa Fragonard and the Parc de Roquevignon round out about six hours, best from June through August.

gem:massif-esterel.text: Massif de l'Esterel is a coastal nature area in France above the beaches of Pampelonne and Frejus Beach. Hiking trails through the reserve near Perthus and a visit to the Lerins Islands fill about six hours, best planned for June, July or August.

gem:puy-mary.text: Puy Mary is a mountain peak in France, reached on foot from the Pas de Peyrol pass between Puy Griou and Plomb du Cantal. Le Lioran adds trails to about seven hours in total, best kept to July or August since public transport up here stays poor.

gem:dimitsana.text: Dimitsana is a small mountain village in Greece on the slopes of Mainalo, close enough to Mount Lykaion and the ruins at Gortys for a longer day out. The village itself takes about two hours to see, best in May or June given the poor public transport.

gem:nisyros.text: Nisyros is a small island in the Dodecanese group of Greece, with the islets of Tilos and Gyali visible offshore. Antimachia Castle and the Alikes Salt Lake round out about four hours, best visited May through September given limited public transport.

gem:paxos-antipaxos.text: Paxos and Antipaxos are a pair of small islands off the coast of Greece, within reach of the hilltop Parga Castle across the water. The pair together takes about four hours to see, best from June through August given limited local transport.

gem:chios-mastic.text: Chios is a large island in the East Aegean Islands group of Greece, its Nea Moni monastery and the village of Anavatos both worth the climb. The Castle of Chios and nearby Oinousses round out about five hours, best visited May through September.

gem:vai-palm-beach.text: Vai Palm Beach is a small coastal spot in Greece known for its palm forest of Vai running down to the sand. Toplou Monastery and the ruins at Itanos make an easy add-on to about two hours here, best kept to May through September given limited transport.

gem:aegina.text: Aegina is one of the Saronic Islands in Greece, its ancient Temple of Aphaea standing above the coast. Varkiza beach and side trips to Poros or Agistri fill out about five hours, best from May through September given limited transport.

gem:spetses.text: Spetses is an island and town in Greece, favored for romantic weekends by the water. Dokos, the Battle of Settepozzi and Franchthi Cave lead the sights, about five hours worth; come in May, June or September before summer crowds arrive.

gem:tsagkarada-pelion.text: Tsagkarada is a village on Pelion in Greece, close to Mylopotamos Beach. Two hours covers the main village, though Iolcos and Milies reward a detour, and May through August suit the mountain air best.

gem:cascata-delle-marmore.text: Cascata delle Marmore is a waterfall area in Italy, popular for family adventure days out near Terni. Lago di Piediluco sits close by for a lake detour, and six hours covers the falls and Monte Terminillo, best tackled in April, May, June or September.

gem:ponza.text: Ponza is a quiet island off Italy, ringed by beaches and coast. Palmarola and Zannone make easy boat trips from the Pontine Islands, with four hours enough for the main sights and June through August the season to go.

gem:lillehammer.text: Lillehammer is a historic ski town in Norway, remembered for hosting the Winter Olympics. Maihaugen and the Norwegian Olympic Museum anchor the sights, about six hours worth, with June through August the best season to visit.

gem:gammelstad.text: Gammelstad is a UNESCO World Heritage village in Sweden, built around its old church town. Gammelstads kyrkstad and Lulea Cathedral fill about three hours, and July is the best month to come, before the quiet fades.

gem:koli.text: Koli National Park in Finland pairs lake views with hiking above Pielinen. Ukko-Koli and the Pirunkirkko cave make for a solid four hours, and July is the one month to plan around here.

gem:kalsoy.text: Kalsoy is a remote hiking island in the Faroe Islands, with a population of seventy. Streymoy and Eysturoy lie within sight, and six hours suffices for trails toward Slaettaratindur, best attempted June through August.

gem:kemeri.text: Kemeri National Park in Latvia mixes bogland with quiet family days out. Lake Kanieris and Kemeri Station lead the five hours worth of sights, with Dubulti and Asari close enough to add on, best June through August.

gem:almourol.text: Castle of Almourol is a fairytale fortress village in Portugal, anchored by the Castelo de Almourol itself. The Convent of Christ and Synagogue of Tomar are worth the side trip, three hours total, best seen in April or May.

gem:fatima.text: Fatima is a quiet pilgrimage town in Portugal, built around the Sanctuary of Fatima. The Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary and the Chapel of the Apparitions fill much of six hours, with May through August the season most visit.

gem:carrapateira.text: Carrapateira is a remote surf village in Portugal, ringed by wild beaches. Two hours takes in Praia do Penedo and Praia da Arrifana, with the Cabo de Sao Vicente Lighthouse a short drive further, best May through September.

gem:odeceixe.text: Odeceixe is a quiet surf village in Portugal near the Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina Natural Park. Praia das Adegas and Praia da Amoreira draw most visitors, three hours all told, with May, June or September the calmest months.

gem:porto-covo.text: Porto Covo is a quiet coastal village in Portugal, facing Pessegueiro Island just offshore. The Fort of Pessegueiro and the Church of Porto Covo make an easy three hours, best from May to July or in September.

gem:vila-vicosa.text: Vila Vicosa is a baroque town in Portugal, centered on its Ducal Palace of Vila Vicosa. The Castle of Vila Vicosa and Fonte das Bicas take five hours, with May the single best month to go.

gem:sortelha.text: Sortelha is a remote fairytale village in Portugal, guarded by its own medieval castle. Sabugal Castle and the Castle of Penamacor sit within reach, five hours worth of stone walls, best visited May, June or September.

gem:ponte-de-lima.text: Ponte de Lima is a romantic wine town in Portugal, set along the Limia River. The Tower of Penegate and Torre da Cadeia keep visitors busy for six hours, best enjoyed June through August in the warmest weather.

gem:horezu.text: Horezu Monastery is a UNESCO World Heritage village in Romania, prized for its historic art and countryside setting. Cula Greceanu and Cula Duca add to three hours nearby, with May through September all good for a visit.

gem:perperikon.text: Perperikon is a remote historic town in Bulgaria, best known today for The Stone Mushrooms nearby. Moniak and Sredna Arda add another four hours, with May, June or September the recommended months.

gem:peratallada.text: Peratallada is a medieval fairytale village in Catalonia, ringed by stone walls. Girona Cathedral and the Medes Islands make good day trips, four hours for the village itself, best from May to July.

gem:monasterio-de-piedra.text: Monasterio de Piedra is a romantic nature area in Spain, built around the Monastery of Piedra itself. Augusta Bilbilis and the Church of San Pedro de los Francos are within reach, five hours total, best May, June, September or October.

gem:carmona.text: Carmona is a historic town in Spain, entered through the Gate of Sevilla. The Alcazar del rey Don Pedro and Iglesia de San Felipe fill five hours easily, best visited in April or May.

gem:aracena.text: Aracena is a countryside food town in Spain, set inside the Sierra de Aracena and Picos de Aroche Natural Park. The Gruta de las Maravillas and Castillo de Aracena take about three hours together, with May the month to time it.

gem:ludlow.text: Ludlow is a medieval market town in the United Kingdom known for food and castles. Ludlow Castle and Richard's Castle are worth six hours together, best tackled June through August.

gem:ironbridge.text: Ironbridge is a UNESCO World Heritage village in Shropshire, named for The Iron Bridge itself. Buildwas Abbey and Wenlock Priory extend a four-hour visit, with June through August the easiest months for it.

gem:tintern-abbey.text: Tintern Abbey is a romantic ruin area in the United Kingdom, set along the River Wye. Chepstow Castle and Harold's Stones round out seven hours of countryside, best from June through September.

gem:durness.text: Durness is a remote area on the north coast of Scotland, edged by cliffs and beaches. Smoo Cave and the Cape Wrath Lighthouse take up five hours, with Ben Hope and Ben Loyal rising behind, best June through August.

gem:kornati.text: Kornati Islands is a national park off Croatia, scattered across the Adriatic. Kornat and the Kornati Archipelago lead four hours of boat-bound sights, best timed for May or June.

gem:zlatibor.text: Zlatibor is a mountain resort village in Serbia, ringed by rivers and forest. Uvac Monastery and Zlatar Lake make an easy two hours, with July and August the season everyone chooses.

gem:bury-st-edmunds.text: Bury St Edmunds is a historic market town in the United Kingdom, built around its cathedral. St Edmundsbury Cathedral and Bury St Edmunds Abbey take six hours, with June through September the easiest months.

gem:bridgnorth.text: Bridgnorth is a historic market town in the United Kingdom, split across two levels above the River Severn. St Leonard's Church and Apley Hall lead five hours of sights, with The Iron Bridge and Ironbridge Gorge a short trip away, best June through August.

gem:chichester.text: Chichester is a cathedral town in the United Kingdom, anchored by Chichester Cathedral itself. Fishbourne Roman Palace and the Chichester Festival Theatre fill six hours easily, with Arundel Cathedral nearby, best June through September.

gem:rugby.text: Rugby is a market town in the United Kingdom, better known for the sport that took its name. Brownsover Hall and Coton House lead nine hours of sights, alongside Dow Bridge and St Andrew, best tackled June through August.

gem:pont-aven.text: Pont-Aven is a historic art village in France, small enough to feel unhurried. The Pont-Aven museum and Chateau de Rustephan fill about three hours, with June through September the liveliest season.

gem:worcester.text: Worcester is a cathedral city in the United Kingdom, its history tied to the Battle of Worcester. Worcester Cathedral and All Saints Church can fill nine hours, with Spetchley and Hindlip Hall further out, best June through September.

gem:lodi.text: Lodi is a historic cathedral town in Italy, centered on Lodi Cathedral. The Tempio Civico della Beata Vergine Incoronata and villa Albergoni round out six hours, with Crema Cathedral a short trip away, best May, June or September.

gem:godalming.text: Godalming is an old market town in the United Kingdom, on the banks of the River Wey. Winkworth Arboretum and Watts Gallery fill much of six hours, with Guildford Cathedral nearby in Surrey, best June through September.

gem:arundel.text: Arundel is a castle village in the United Kingdom, built around Arundel Castle itself. Arundel Cathedral and the South Downs fill four hours nearby, with Chichester Cathedral a short trip further, best June through September.

gem:chorley.text: Chorley is a market town in Lancashire, ringed by the West Pennine Moors. Astley Hall and the Winter Hill transmitting station take up six hours, with Blackburn Cathedral not far off, best June through August.

gem:soria.text: Soria is a historic cathedral town in Castile and Leon, Spain, known for its Romanesque churches. The Co-cathedral of San Pedro and the Monastery of San Juan de Duero take six hours, best June through September.

gem:biel-bienne.text: Biel/Bienne pairs cathedral history with an art scene in Switzerland, Pasquart Kunsthaus its headline stop. Nidau and Orvin take nine hours, best kept to June through September, close to Lake Biel.

gem:kington.text: Kington is a market town in the United Kingdom, Offa's Dyke its best known trail. Hergest Ridge and Kington Museum need about three hours; June through August work best, though public transport runs poor.

gem:potes.text: Picos de Europa National Park frames Potes, a village in Spain built around Santo Toribio de Liebana. The Cantabrian Mountains and Naranjo de Bulnes add up to three hours, with May through September the better window.

gem:coburg.text: Veste Coburg towers over Coburg, a historic town in Germany with a cathedral of its own. June through September suit it best, Schloss Rosenau and Ehrenburg Palace filling six hours.

gem:stamford.text: Stamford, a market town in the United Kingdom, gathers Burghley House and St Leonard's Priory within reach of its center. Rutland Water and Fotheringhay Castle make for six hours, timed well to June through September.

gem:keszthely.text: Festetics Palace anchors Keszthely, a town in Hungary on the shore of Lake Heviz. Aim for May, June, August or September; Keszthely Synagogue and the wider circuit take five hours, Badacsony rising across the water.

gem:cingoli.text: Cingoli is a village in Italy included among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia. San Catervo and the Basilica of Saint Nicholas of Tolentino hold three hours, especially good June through August, Frasassi Caves and Monte San Vicino nearby.

gem:rieti.text: Rieti centers on its Cathedral and Palazzo Comunale, a historic town in Italy. Monte Terminillo and Aquae Cutiliae take six hours, best during May or June, Lago di Piediluco a short trip away.

gem:bad-durkheim.text: Hambach Castle and Burgruine Hardenburg overlook Bad Durkheim, a historic town in Germany. Kriemhildenstuhl and Eckkopf take six hours, best kept to May through September, Grosse Blies nearby for a swim.

gem:figeac.text: Figeac is a town in France carrying the Les Plus Beaux Detours de France label, its Champollion Museum the main draw. Chateau de Puy-Launay and Tour de Sagnes need about five hours; May through September work best.

gem:flensburg.text: Flensburg mixes cathedral history with art in Germany, Glucksburg Castle its grandest sight. The Isted Lion adds up to ten hours, with June through August the better window, Ostseebad beach within reach.

gem:ermelo.text: Ermelo, a historic town in the Netherlands, sits among the Wolderwijd and Veluwemeer waters. June through August suit it best, Nuldernauw, Nijkerkernauw and Eemmeer filling six hours of sightseeing.

gem:sluis.text: Sluis is a historic village in the Netherlands built around the Zwin nature area. Bruges lies close enough to add the Church of Our Lady and the Belfry of Bruges, making for four hours, timed well to June through August.

gem:collbato.text: Montserrat mountain rises over Collbato, a village in Spain, its Santa Maria de Montserrat monastery the reason to stop. Aim for May or June; Museum of Montserrat and La Mola take four hours.

gem:laon.text: Laon Cathedral rises over the plain in Laon, a historic town in France. Premontre Abbey and Vauclair Abbey hold six hours, especially good June through September, Lac de l'Ailette close by.

gem:eslov.text: Bosjokloster and Svenstorps slott anchor a castle trail through Eslov, a town in Sweden. All Saints Church, Viderup Castle and Skarhults slott take six hours, best during June through August.

gem:airolo.text: Airolo sits at the foot of the Gotthard Pass in the Swiss Alps. Furka Pass and the Rhone Glacier take four hours, best kept to June through August, with Oberalpsee and Lago del Naret nearby.

gem:toras.text: Toras is grouped among the Conjunto historico towns of Spain, Segorbe Cathedral within easy reach. Sierra del Toro and Sierra de Andilla need about three hours; May, June, September or October work best.

gem:hechingen.text: Burg Hohenzollern castle overlooks Hechingen, a town in Germany with good public transport. Zeller Horn and Heiligenkopf add up to six hours, with June through September the better window.

gem:avoise.text: Avoise is listed among the Petites Cites de Caractere in France, close enough to Solesmes Abbey to visit both. May through September suit it best, Chateau de Verdelles and the manoir de Beauce filling three hours.

gem:riedenburg.text: Weltenburg Abbey and Befreiungshalle mark the skyline over Riedenburg, a historic village in Germany. Schloss Hexenagger and Plankstetten Abbey make for four hours, timed well to May through September, Kratzmuhlsee good for a swim after.

gem:jindrichuv-hradec.text: A castle and a synagogue anchor the old center of Jindrichuv Hradec, a historic town in Czechia. Aim for May through September; Kryza's creche and the Holy Trinity column take six hours.

gem:alarcon.text: Castillo de Alarcon rises above the gorge in Alarcon, one of the Conjunto historico artistico towns of Spain. Church of Santa Maria del Campo and Santo Domingo de Silos hold two hours, especially good May or September, the Alarcon Reservoir below.

gem:bad-reichenhall.text: Jenner and Watzmann rise close to Bad Reichenhall, a historic town in Germany. Hohensalzburg Fortress and Salzburg Cathedral nearby take six hours, best during May through September.

gem:aguilar-de-campoo.text: Aguilar de Campoo gathers its Monastery of Santa Maria la Real, a historic village in Spain. The Castle of Aguilar de Campoo and Monte Bernorio take three hours, best kept to June through September.

gem:saint-bonnet-de-rochefort.text: Saint-Bonnet-de-Rochefort is a historic village in France close to the Gour de Tazenat and the Viaduc de Rouzat. Chateau de Veauce and Chateau de Gannat need about three hours; May through September work best.

gem:melle.text: Eglise Saint-Hilaire de Melle anchors Melle, a village listed among the Petites Cites de Caractere in France. Abbaye Royale and the Tumulus of Bougon add up to two hours, with May through September the better window.

gem:thann.text: Thann carries the Les Plus Beaux Detours de France label below the Grand Ballon in France. June through September suit it best, Murbach Abbey and Hartmannswillerkopf filling six hours.

gem:wladyslawowo.text: Wladyslawowo is a historic beach town in Poland, Lunapark Sowinski and Klanino Palace among its stops. Hallerowka and the Rozewie sites make for five hours, timed well to June through August.

gem:uruena.text: Uruena is grouped among the Conjunto historico towns of Spain, the Colegiata de San Luis at its heart. Aim for May, June or September; Iglesia de San Cipriano and La Santa Espina take two hours.

gem:castro-caldelas.text: Castro Caldelas rises above the Sil Canyon in Spain, a historic village. Monasterio de San Vicente del Pino and the Serra de San Mamede hold three hours, especially good June through September, Mount Cabeza de Manzaneda on the horizon.

gem:pszczyna.text: Pszczyna Castle and the Zamek w Pszczynie grounds anchor Pszczyna, a historic town in Poland. The Princely Pheasantry and castle grounds take six hours, best during May through September.

gem:andermatt.text: Andermatt sits at a crossing of mountain routes in Switzerland, the Gotthard Pass chief among them. The Gotthard Tunnel and Rhone Glacier take four hours, best kept to June through August, Titlis visible in the distance.

gem:krynica-zdroj.text: Krynica-Zdroj lies in the Low Beskids of Poland, the Church of the Holy Apostles Peter and Paul in Tylicz among its stops. Brunary and the district need about six hours; June through August work best, Lake Klimkowka close by.

gem:novalja.text: Novalja is a historic beach village on the island of Pag in Croatia, close to Zrce and Rucica Beach. The Northern Velebit National Park adds up to two hours, with May or June the better window, Olib and Maun visible offshore.

gem:borlange.text: Borlange sits along the Runn lake in Sweden, Ornasstugan among its landmarks. June through August suit it best, Domnarvsvallen, Stora Tuna socken and Aspeboda socken filling six hours.

gem:karlshamn.text: Carl Gustafs kyrka overlooks the coast at Karlshamn, a coastal town in Sweden. Tarno, Elleholms socken and Hallaryds socken make for six hours, timed well to June through August, Morrums socken close by.

gem:wedde.text: Wedde is a historic village in the Netherlands near Bourtange Fortress and its Magnuskerk church. Aim for June through August; Spinnenkop Wedderveer and the Kerk van Wedde take four hours, Oldambtmeer close by.

gem:laax.text: Laax is grouped with Flims, Sagogn and Valendas among the historic villages of Switzerland. Crap Sogn Gion and Castrisch hold four hours, especially good June through August, Ringelspitz rising above Crestasee.

gem:krk.text: Krk Cathedral anchors Krk, a historic beach village in Croatia near Cres. Plavnik, Kosljun and the Biserujka cave take two hours, best during May through August, Obzova rising above the coast.

gem:loppersum.text: Loppersum is a village in the Netherlands near Groningen, its cathedral quarter built around St Joseph Cathedral and the Groninger Museum, worth about four hours in June, July or August, with Woldmeer lake close by for afterward.

gem:zamardi.text: Zamardi sits on Lake Balaton in Hungary, a beach village handy for day trips to Balatonfured and Tihany Abbey. May, June and September are kindest, with three hours enough for the village itself before summer crowds peak.

gem:trebnje.text: Trebnje is a village in Slovenia known for castle ruins such as Grad Lansprez and Grad Rakovnik scattered through the hills around it. Its sites take roughly three hours, and Kum mountain rises nearby for wider views, best from May through August.

gem:ronne.text: Ronne is the main town on Bornholm in Denmark, home to Erichsens Gard and the Ronne Lighthouse along its harbor. A five hour circuit takes in both, best done June through August, with Antoinette beach close by for a swim after.

gem:fagersta.text: Fagersta is a town in Vastmanland, Sweden, built around the old Engelsberg Ironworks beside the lake Amanningen. Its ironworks and Vastanfors Church fill about four hours, and the lake makes for a good swim from June to August.

gem:frymburk.text: Frymburk is a lakeside village in Czechia on Lipno Reservoir, within reach of Cesky Krumlov Castle and Rozmberk Castle. A relaxed look around takes about four hours, with Klet mountain close by for a clear day hike from June to August.

gem:stavern.text: Stavern is a small coastal village in Norway built around Kaupang and the Minnehallen war memorial, with Grenland Bridge nearby, roughly four hours worth of sights best seen in June or July, when Farris lake warms enough to swim.

gem:polanczyk.text: Polanczyk is a lakeside village in Poland on Lake Solina, surrounded by small historic churches in places like Bereznica Wyzna and Orelec. A morning covers the village, three hours at most, best from June to August when boats fill the lake.

gem:rosegg.text: Rosegg is a small village in Austria on Lake Ossiach, close to Worthersee and the peaks of Mittagskogel and Dreilandereck. The castle grounds and lake views fill about four hours, and the water stays swimmable May through September.

gem:suvereto.text: Suvereto is a stone hill village built around the Rocca di San Silvestro fortress in Italy, near the mining park at Parco Archeominerario di San Silvestro. May, June and July suit it best, and the two sights together take roughly three hours.

gem:troina.text: Troina is a hill town in Italy above Lago di Ancipa, its skyline marked by the chiesa madre and the Rocca di San Pantheon, with Lago Maulazzo nearby for a detour. June, July and August suit it best, when four hours covers the main sights.

gem:ingria.text: Ingria is a tiny alpine village home to just eleven people, beneath Cima Mares and Cima Rosta in Italy near Gran Paradiso. Its pieve at Santa Maria in Doblazio and the trails toward Lake Miserin fill close to three hours, best June to September.

gem:gravelines.text: Gravelines is a fortified town in France built around the City walls of Gravelines and the harbor lighthouse at Phare de Gravelines, with the Beffroi and Eglise Saint-Jean-Baptiste nearby, a five hour walk best done June through August.

gem:rocroi.text: Rocroi is a star shaped village in France, its City walls of Rocroi and the Cite jardin Faure garden district the reason for a short stop. Two hours is enough to walk the ramparts and reach the Eglise des Dominicains de Revin, best June through August.

gem:mombaldone.text: Mombaldone is a fortified hilltop village whose lanes pass the Cappella di Santa Rosalia and the Chiesa di San Pietro, in Italy, on the way to the Torre di Roccaverano. Two hours covers the whole village, quietest in May, June or September.

gem:pontechianale.text: Pontechianale is a small mountain village at the foot of Monviso in Italy, near the pass at Col Agnel and the peak of Viso Mozzo, easily seen in about three hours, best done June through August once Monte Viso trails clear of snow.

gem:ambert.text: Ambert is a village in France known for the historic paper mill at Moulin Richard de Bas and the dolmen at La Pierre Couverte. Two hours takes in the mill and the dolmen, best from June to September, and transport connections here are good.

gem:golferenzo.text: Golferenzo is a hilltop village near Santa Maria della Versa and the fortress ruins of Rocca di Messer Fiorello, in Italy. Its neighbors Montalto Pavese and Volpara round out some three hours, best kept to May, June or September.

gem:varese-ligure.text: Varese Ligure is a quiet village built around the Chiesa di San Giovanni Battista and the Chiesa di San Lorenzo in Italy, and Monte Gottero and Lago di Giacopiane sit nearby. May, June and July are the best months, and three hours covers the village center.

gem:rocca-san-giovanni.text: Rocca San Giovanni is a coastal village known for the abbey of San Giovanni in Venere above the sea in Italy, and the Chiesa di San Francesco is a short trip away in Lanciano, roughly three hours for both, best from May to August.

gem:ortignano-raggiolo.text: Ortignano Raggiolo is a small village below Pratomagno mountain in Italy, its center marked by the Chiesa della Madonna del Morbo and the Propositura dei Santi Marco e Lorenzo. May and June suit it best, three hours enough for the churches.

gem:fagagna.text: Fagagna is an old village home to the Biblioteca Guarneriana library and the Duomo di San Michele Arcangelo in Italy, the two worth three hours or so in May or June, with Lago di Cornino a short drive away.

gem:civita.text: Civita is a hillside village above the Gole del Raganello gorge in Italy, near the Santuario Santa Maria delle Armi and the Cattedrale. Two hours covers the village, best in May, June or September, when the gorge trails stay cool.

gem:montecchio.text: Montecchio is a riverside village near the Castello di Alviano and the Parco fluviale del Tevere in Italy, along Lake Alviano. Two hours takes in the castle and the riverside park, with Guardea nearby for a longer loop, best May, June or September.

gem:morano-calabro.text: Morano Calabro is a hill village stacked beneath Monte Pollino in Italy, its santuario della Madonna del Castello at the highest point, a three hour climb best made in May or June, Serra Dolcedorme and Serra del Prete rising above.

gem:santa-severina.text: Santa Severina is a plateau village perched above the cliffs of Timpa del Salto in Italy, its Cattedrale di Santa Anastasia and Museo Diocesano set at the highest point. Two hours covers the cathedral and museum, best in May or June.

gem:paimpol.text: Paimpol is a harbor town built around the ruined Abbaye de Beauport and the old windmill at Moulin de Craca in France, with the Chapelle Notre-Dame de Kergrist a short walk on. The three sights together take about five hours, June through September.

gem:bugnara.text: Bugnara is a modest village below Monte Amaro in Italy, home to the Cattedrale di San Panfilo and the Chiesa di Santa Maria del Colle, best seen in nearly three hours during May or June, with Sulmona and Lago di Scanno a short drive out.

gem:castro-dei-volsci.text: Castro dei Volsci is a hill village near the caves at Grotte di Pastena and the nature reserve at Grotte di Falvaterra e Rio Obaco, in Italy. Two hours takes in the village center, mildest in April, May, June or September.

gem:magliano-sabina.text: Magliano Sabina is a hillside village above the ruins of Ocriculum in Italy, near the Museo Civico Archeologico and the Cattedrale di San Liberatore. Two hours covers the ruins and the cathedral, best in April or May before the summer heat.

gem:petralia-soprana.text: Petralia Soprana is a hilltop village with Santa Maria Maggiore and the Chiesa di Sant'Anna among its landmarks, in Italy, the Castello di Geraci visible on a neighboring ridge. A walk through takes about three hours, busiest and warmest June through August.

gem:cervo.text: Cervo is a clifftop village above the sea in Italy, its castello di Cervo and the Giardino Villa Grock garden facing the Faro di Capo Mele lighthouse, easily seen in three hours altogether, pleasant anytime from May through September.

gem:montelupone.text: Montelupone is an old village centered on the Teatro Giuseppe Persiani and the Museo Civico Villa Colloredo Mels in Italy, and the Palazzo Leopardi and Chiesa San Francesco sit nearby, three hours in all, best in June, July or August.

gem:venzone.text: Venzone is a walled village between Monte Amariana and Monte Plauris in Italy, its Priorato di Santo Spirito set inside those walls. The walk around takes about three hours, May through September, with Lago di Cornino a short drive out.

gem:gesualdo.text: Gesualdo is an old village near the ruins of Aeclanum and the sulfur springs at La Mefite, in Italy. Two hours takes in the archaeological park and the Fontana monumentale, best in May or June before the summer crowds.

gem:louhans-chateaurenaud.text: Louhans-Chateaurenaud is a market town known for the Hotel-Dieu de Louhans and the Tour Saint-Pierre in France, with the Chateau de Montcony a short trip out, easily filling three hours from May through September, and transport connections here are good.

gem:pont-croix.text: Pont-Croix is a coastal village with two lighthouses within reach, the Phare du Millier and the Phare de Kergadec, in France, plus the Passerelle des Capucins nearby, roughly three hours to see them all, near Plage des Sables Blancs, June through September.

gem:zavattarello.text: Zavattarello is a compact village built around the Castello Dal Verme in Italy, near Varzi and Fortunago, both close enough for a combined day out. The castle itself takes three hours, give or take, best in May, June, July or September.

gem:rocca-pietore.text: Rocca Pietore is an alpine village at the foot of the Marmolada glacier in Italy, near Passo Giau, close to three hours for the village and a look at the glacier, June through August, Lake Alleghe below for a swim after.

gem:collalto-sabino.text: Collalto Sabino is a tiny village near the cave reserve at Grotte di Pietrasecca and the Castello di Carsoli in Italy, Monte Cervia rising behind, some three hours for a walk through the village, June through August, Lago del Salto a short drive away.

gem:cipressa.text: Cipressa is a small village in Italy. Costa Balenae opens the visit, with San Domenico and the Faro di Capo dell'Arma close behind; give it three hours, ideally June through August.

gem:montecosaro.text: Montecosaro is an old village in Italy. Chiesa San Francesco and Chiesa di San Marone come first among the sights, near the port of Civitanova Marche; reckon on three hours, best June through August.

gem:san-ginesio.text: San Ginesio, in Italy, centers on Castello Pallotta and the Collegiata di San Martino, close to Sant'Agostino and Santa Maria di Piazza Alta; a three hour walk takes it in, ideally in June.

gem:pretoro.text: Pretoro sits below Monte Amaro in Italy. The Abbazia di San Liberatore a Majella heads the sights, with the Eremo di Santo Spirito a Majella close by; figure on four hours, best May or June.

gem:altomonte.text: Altomonte is built around the Cattedrale di San Nicola di Mira in Italy. Santa Maria della Consolazione and the Eparchy of Lungro round out the sights; two hours covers it, best in May or June.

gem:arlempdes.text: Arlempdes, in France, centers on the Chateau d'Arlempdes, Chateau de Beaufort and Eglise Saint-Felix de Landos. Lac d'Issarles and Lac du Bouchet sit close by; plan three hours, best June through September.

gem:cambo-les-bains.text: Cambo-les-Bains is a village in France, home to nearly five thousand people. Villa Arnaga tops the sights, below Larrun and Artzamendi; public transport is good, and three hours takes it in, June through September.

gem:offagna.text: Offagna, in Italy, sits near the Spiaggia Urbani and Spiaggia di San Michele beaches. The Selva di Gallignano and Rocca di Offagna head the sights; June to August suit it, roughly three hours needed.

gem:moresco.text: Moresco is a small village in Italy, home to just over three hundred people. The Teatro dell'Aquila and Duomo di Fermo, in nearby Fermo, draw visitors; three hours fits, best May through August.

gem:vigo-di-fassa.text: Vigo di Fassa sits in the Val di Fassa in Italy, with the Vajolet Towers and Val Duron among the draws. Marmolada and Sassolungo rise close by; budget three hours, best June through August.

gem:san-marco-d-alunzio.text: San Marco d'Alunzio overlooks the Rocche del Crasto in Italy. The Chiesa dell'Aracoeli and Ponte Nuovo top the sights, near Lago Maulazzo; two hours covers it, best in May or June.

gem:irsina.text: Irsina is a village in Italy, home to nearly five thousand people. The Cattedrale di Santa Maria Assunta and Bottini di Irsina head the sights; two hours is typical, best in May, June or September.

gem:lyons-la-foret.text: Lyons-la-Foret is a village in France. It keeps the Abbaye de Mortemer, Abbaye de l'Isle-Dieu and chateau de Vascoeuil among its sights; a three hour visit suits it, best June through September.

gem:luserna.text: Luserna sits near Cima Dodici in Italy. Forte Luserna and Forte Vezzena top the sights on Monte Verena, with Lago di Caldonazzo close by; three hours suits it, June through August.

gem:apremont-sur-allier.text: Apremont-sur-Allier centers on the Chateau d'Apremont-sur-Allier in France. The Chateau de Meauce and Eglise Saint-Julien de Mars-sur-Allier add to the sights; two hours covers it, best May through September.

gem:malestroit.text: Malestroit is a village in France. Its dolmen de la Maison Trouvee and Eglise Saint-Gilles de Malestroit head the sights; May through September is the season, three hours or so needed.

gem:lavaudieu.text: Lavaudieu grew up around the Lavaudieu Abbey in France, still its centerpiece. The Chateau de Domeyrat adds to the sights nearby; three hours works well, best May through September.

gem:saint-jean-de-cole.text: Saint-Jean-de-Cole sits near the Villars Cave in France. The Chateau de Bruzac and Chateau de Puyguilhem come first among the sights; few need more than three hours, best May through September.

gem:montreal.text: Montreal is a village in France, home to just over one thousand people. The Eglise Saint-Pierre de Genens and Pont d'Artigues top the sights; May, June and September suit it best, three hours or so.

gem:la-bastide-clairence.text: La Bastide-Clairence sits near Artzamendi in France. The Salle d'Isturitz and Eglise Saint-Jean-Baptiste top the sights, close to Hasparren; a three hour visit suits it, best May through September.

gem:olargues.text: Olargues overlooks the gorges d'Heric in France. The Eglise Saint-Laurent d'Olargues, Pont du Diable and Tour carree de Colombieres-sur-Orb head the sights; May, June and September suit a three hour visit.

gem:segur-le-chateau.text: Segur-le-Chateau sits near the Chateau de Pompadour in France. The Haras national de Pompadour and Eglise Saint-Etienne de Lubersac draw visitors nearby; June through September is the season, three hours enough.

gem:laroquebrou.text: Laroquebrou is a village in France. The Eglise Saint-Martin de Laroquebrou tops the sights, near Lac du Tolerme, with good public transport; three hours suits it, June through September.

gem:salies-de-bearn.text: Salies-de-Bearn, in France, is known for the Chateau de Bellocq and Thermes de Salies-de-Bearn, with the Pont de la Legende nearby. Its season runs May, June, July and September; three hours does it.

gem:le-bec-hellouin.text: Le Bec-Hellouin grew around the Abbaye Notre-Dame du Bec in France. The Chateau d'Harcourt and Chateau de Tilly lie nearby in Eure; top months are June through September, three hours or so.

gem:saint-leonard-de-noblat.text: Saint-Leonard-de-Noblat, in France, is built around the Collegiale de Saint-Leonard-de-Noblat. The Dolmen du Pouyol sits nearby; June through September is best, about three hours needed.

gem:gerberoy.text: Gerberoy centers on the Collegiale Saint-Pierre de Gerberoy in France. The Abbaye de Lannoy and Beaupre Abbey lie nearby, with the Eglise Saint-Denis d'Hodenc-en-Bray close by; set aside three hours, best June through September.

gem:mortemart.text: Mortemart, in France, counts the Menhir de Ceinturat and Dolmen de Rouffignac among its ancient sights. The Couvent des Carmes de Mortemart rounds things out; June through September works best, three hours enough.

gem:domfront.text: Domfront is a village in France. The Chateau de Domfront, Enceinte de Domfront and Abbaye de Lonlay head the sights; not much more than three hours is needed, best June through September.

gem:verneuil-sur-avre.text: Verneuil-sur-Avre, in France, is built around the Eglise de la Madeleine and Eglise Saint-Jean, near the Menhir de la Pierre de la Jourre. Its season runs June through September; three hours does it justice.

gem:crissay-sur-manse.text: Crissay-sur-Manse sits near L'Ile-Bouchard in France. The Saint-Gilles church and Eglise Saint-Nicolas de Tavant top the sights nearby; a three hour visit suits it, best May through September.

gem:lauzerte.text: Lauzerte, in France, counts the Eglise Saint-Barthelemy de Lauzerte among its sights. The Eglise Saint-Christophe de Touffailles lies nearby; two hours suits it, best May through September.
