gem:grimaud.text: Grimaud is a village in France. Port Grimaud, the Chateau de Grimaud and Chateau Bertaud head the sights, near Pampelonne beach; April, May and September suit it best, three hours or so.

gem:saint-yrieix-la-perche.text: Saint-Yrieix-la-Perche, in France, is built around the Collegiale Saint-Yrieix. The Pont de la Tour and Forge de Bessous sit nearby; two hours suits it, best June through September.

gem:pouzauges.text: Pouzauges centers on the Chateau de Pouzauges in France. The Donjon de Chateaumur and Chateau du Fief-Milon lie nearby; June through September is the season, about three hours needed.

gem:sauxillanges.text: Sauxillanges sits near the Chateau de Parentignat in France. The Eglise Saint-Sebastien de Manglieu and Eglise Saint-Julien de Bansat lie nearby; its best months run June through September, three hours or so.

gem:seillans.text: Seillans sits near the Chapelle Notre-Dame-de-l'Ormeau in France. The Eglise Notre-Dame de Favas and Dolmen d'Avaye top the sights; May through August suits it best, three hours enough.

gem:villebois-lavalette.text: Villebois-Lavalette centers on the Chateau de Villebois-Lavalette in France. The Chateau de la Mercerie and Chateau de la Rochebeaucourt lie nearby; a three hour visit suits it, best May through September.

gem:le-puy-notre-dame.text: Le Puy-Notre-Dame sits near the Chateau de Montreuil-Bellay in France. The Dolmen du Griffier and Prieure des Nobis lie nearby; few need more than three hours, best May through September.

gem:saint-florent-le-vieil.text: Saint-Florent-le-Vieil, in France, is home to the Chapelle Cathelineau and Palais Briau. The Chateau de la Baronniere lies nearby; May through September is the season, three hours or so.

gem:farnham.text: Farnham is a historic market town in the United Kingdom, built around Farnham Castle and Waverley Abbey. Aldershot Observatory and Farnham Pottery round out a visit of six hours, best from June through September.

gem:nonette.text: Nonette is a small historic village in France, one of the Petites Cites de Caractere. Chateau de Villeneuve-Lembron and Eglise Saint-Nicolas de Nonette lead a short visit, three hours from June to September.

gem:witney.text: Witney is a historic market town in the United Kingdom. Bampton Castle and Devil's Quoits headline a five hour visit, with North Leigh Roman Villa and Hinksey Lake nearby, best June through September.

gem:wimborne-minster.text: Wimborne Minster is a historic market town in the United Kingdom. Kingston Lacy and Dudsbury Camp anchor six hours of sightseeing, and Bournemouth Beach sits close by for a break, best June to September.

gem:wotton-under-edge.text: Wotton-under-Edge is a historic market town in the United Kingdom. Newark Park, Owlpen Manor and the Ancient Ram Inn fill about four hours, with Stinchcombe and the Uley Long Barrow nearby, at their best from June to September.

gem:uttoxeter.text: Uttoxeter is a historic market town in the United Kingdom. Sudbury Hall and Croxden Abbey top the sights, with Denstone College adding more, five hours in total from June to August.

gem:yarm.text: Yarm is a historic market town in the United Kingdom, set by the Yarm Viaduct. Rudby Hall, Acklam Hall and Sockburn Hall fill six hours, with Stockton close by, best June and August.

gem:wye.text: Wye is a small historic market town in the United Kingdom. Julliberrie's Grave and Chilham Castle lead the sights, and the Kent Downs AONB rewards a short three hour stop, June through September.

gem:ussaramanna.text: Ussaramanna is a small village in Italy. Su Nuraxi and Giara di Gesturi lead the sights, with the Nuraghe Genna Maria and Tomba di Giganti close behind, about three hours in all, best kept to April or May.

gem:arromanches-les-bains.text: Arromanches-les-Bains is a village on the coast of France, near Gold Beach and Juno Beach. Augustodurum, Ryes War Cemetery and the Chateau de Magny-en-Bessin fill four hours, at their best in June, July or August.

FAO.text: Faro is a beach city in the Algarve, on the coast of Portugal. The Cathedral of Faro and the Ria Formosa lead nine hours of sightseeing, with Falesia Beach nearby, best from May through September.

KGS.text: Kos is a Greek island in the Dodecanese, known for beaches and nightlife. The Mausoleum at Halicarnassus, Bodrum Castle and Pserimos lead six hours of sightseeing, best April through June.

MJT.text: Mytilene is a quiet island in Greece, the capital of Lesvos. The Castle of Mytilene, the Yeni Mosque and the Archaeological Museum of Mytilene anchor five hours, best May, June or September.

CGN.text: Cologne-Bonn is a historic cathedral city in Germany. Lanxess Arena and the Hohenzollern Bridge lead six hours of sights, with Schloss Bensberg further out, best May through September.

KIR.text: Kerry is a coastal village in Ireland, close to Killarney National Park and Lough Leane. Ross Castle, Muckross House and the Slieve Mish Mountains make for two full hours, best June through August.

GCI.text: Guernsey is a quiet island in the United Kingdom, off Sark, Herm and Jethou. Castle Cornet leads seven hours of sightseeing, with the Saumarez Nature Trail nearby, best from June through September.

gem:bad-ischl.text: Bad Ischl is a spa village in the Salzkammergut region of Austria. The Kaiservilla and the lakes Attersee, Traunsee and Wolfgangsee fill four hours, best May through September, though public transport runs thin.

gem:texel.text: Texel is a quiet island in the Netherlands, good for families. Dunes of Texel National Park, the Eierland Lighthouse and Museum Kaap Skil lead seven hours, near Vliehors, best kept to June, July or August.

gem:pecs.text: Pecs is a Roman and Ottoman city in Hungary and a former European Capital of Culture. Ten hours cover the Mosque of Pasha Qasim and Pecs Cathedral, best April, May, June or September.

gem:saaremaa.text: Saaremaa is a remote Estonian island on the UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List. Kuressaare Castle and the Kaali crater lead six hours of sightseeing, best kept to July or August.

gem:rye.text: Rye is a medieval coastal town in the United Kingdom. Bodiam Castle, Camber Castle and the Rye Castle Museum top six hours of sightseeing, with Camber Sands for afterward, June to August being the best window.

gem:aarhus.text: Aarhus is a city in Denmark known for art and food, and a former European Capital of Culture. Ten hours take in the Moesgaard Museum, Aarhus City Hall and ARoS Aarhus Kunstmuseum, ideally between June and August.

gem:odense.text: Odense is a fairytale city on Funen in Denmark, the largest on the island, home to Andersens Hus. Saint Canute's Cathedral, Odense Zoo and Nonnebakken round out ten hours, best kept to June, July or August.

gem:polis-akamas.text: Polis and Akamas is a quiet coastal village in Cyprus, near the Blue Lagoon. Yeronisos, the Agios Neophytos Monastery and Paphos Forest make for a brief two hour visit, best in April or May.

gem:bojnice.text: Bojnice is a fairytale castle town in central Slovakia. Bojnice Zoo and the Strazov Mountains lead three hours, with Vtacnik and Ziar rising beyond, best from May through September.

gem:rauma.text: Rauma is a UNESCO listed town on the coast of Finland. Old Rauma and the Rauma Maritime Museum fill five hours, with the Sammallahdenmaki burial site further out, best July or August.

gem:cambados.text: Cambados is a wine and food town on the coast of Spain. Monasterio de Armenteira and Illa da Toxa lead five hours, and the Beach of A Lanzada waits nearby, best June through August.

gem:gouda.text: Gouda is a historic Dutch city, quieter than it looks on a cheese label. Museum Gouda and Museumhaven Gouda fill ten hours, with the Reeuwijkse Plassen for later, best May through August.

gem:marsaxlokk.text: Marsaxlokk is a fishing village in the south-east of Malta, known for its food. Filfla and Valletta are worth four hours, with Saint George's Beach and Ta' Dmejrek nearby, best May through August.

gem:trencin.text: Trencin is a castle city in Slovakia and a former European Capital of Culture. Trencin Castle leads eight hours of sightseeing, with the Biele Karpaty Protected Landscape Area beyond it, best May through September.

gem:cobh.text: Cobh is a historic port town in Ireland, overlooking Cork Harbour. St Colman's Cathedral, Spike Island and Barryscourt Castle make up five hours, with Cuskinny Marsh Bird Sanctuary nearby, ideally June to August.

gem:marbella.text: Marbella is a luxury beach city in Spain, along the Costa del Sol. Plaza de los Naranjos and Sierra Blanca fill nine hours, with La Torrecilla rising above, best May, June or September.

gem:dartmoor.text: Dartmoor is a wilderness village in the United Kingdom, built around Dartmoor National Park. Wistman's Wood and Buckfast Abbey are worth three hours between June and August, though transport is poor.

gem:middelburg.text: Middelburg is a medieval town on Walcheren in the Netherlands, reachable via Station Middelburg. Middelburg Abbey leads six hours, with Vlissingen, Arnemuiden and the Veerse Meer nearby, ideally in June, July or August.

gem:enkhuizen.text: Enkhuizen is a historic harbour town on the coast of the Netherlands. The Zuiderzeemuseum, Drommedaris and Sprookjeswonderland fill six hours by the IJsselmeer and Markermeer, best June through August.

gem:naarden.text: Naarden is a fortress town in the Netherlands, ringed by star shaped walls. Six hours cover the fortifications, Muiderslot and Singer Laren, by the Gooimeer, ideally June to August.

gem:lier.text: Lier is a quiet historic town in Belgium, near Boechout. The Museum Plantin-Moretus and Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekathedraal lead six hours, with Nijlen and Berlaar close by, best May through September.

gem:lonstrup.text: Lonstrup is a coastal village in Denmark, known for the Rubjerg Knude lighthouse. Marup Church and the Nordsoen Oceanarium round out three hours, best July or August, though transport is poor.

gem:kremnica.text: Kremnica is a medieval town in Slovakia. Zvolen Castle and the wooden church of Hronsek lead three hours, with the Kremnica Mountains and Jastrabska skala nearby, best May through September.

gem:visegrad-hu.text: Visegrad is a castle village in Hungary, near the Duna-Ipoly NP. The Maria Valeria Bridge and Esztergom Basilica lead three hours, with Csovanyos and the Borzsony hills beyond, best April, May, June or September.

gem:veszprem.text: Veszprem is a historic castle city in Hungary, part of the UNESCO Creative Cities Network. Its cathedral and the Petofi Theatre draw visitors first, with the Veszprem Arena nearby; eight hours suits a full visit, best from May through September.

gem:vipava-valley.text: Vipava Valley is a quiet wine region in Slovenia known for its countryside and food. Ajdovscina and Vipava town anchor a visit, with the Skocjan Caves and Miramare Castle further afield, and seven hours is typical in May or June.

gem:lake-cerknica.text: Lake Cerknica is a wilderness area in Slovenia centered on its lake, quiet and light on crowds. Predjama Castle and Postojna Cave lie nearby and fill most of a day, about seven hours, best planned for May through August.

gem:lichtenstein-castle.text: Lichtenstein Castle is a fairytale castle and small town in Germany, romantic and quiet. Reutlingen and the Nebelhohle caves sit close by, with the Swabian Jura filling the view; six hours covers it, best in June, July or August.

gem:boppard.text: Boppard is a wine town on the Rhine in Germany, set where the river bends sharply below the Lorelei. Marksburg and the Ehrenbreitstein Fortress in nearby Koblenz round out a visit of about six hours, best from May through September.

gem:stubaital-neustift.text: Neustift is an alpine village in Austria, close to skiing and hiking trails. Fulpmes and the Brenner Pass fill a short day of about four hours, with the Europabrucke and Serles nearby; June through August is the easiest time to go.

gem:soglio.text: Soglio is a remote alpine village in Switzerland, valued for quiet over crowds. Vicosoprano and Castasegna sit below, with the Maloja Pass and Splugen Pass framing the drive; reckon on seven hours, best in June, July or August.

gem:ruinaulta.text: Ruinaulta is a village in Switzerland known for wild nature and hiking trails. Flims and Trin anchor the area, with Sagogn and Versam close by and the Crestasee lake nearby; four hours covers it well, best from May through September.

gem:heligoland.text: Heligoland is a small, remote island in Germany, quiet and light on visitors. Lange Anna and the Dune fill about six hours, with the lighthouse and Museum Helgoland rounding out a visit, best in June, July or August.

gem:ulm.text: Ulm is a historic city in Germany known for art and its towering minster. Ulm Minster tops the list, with Kloster Wiblingen and the Museum der Brotkultur filling out a ten-hour visit, best from June through September.

gem:mayrhofen.text: Mayrhofen is an alpine village in Austria known for skiing and hiking. Penken and the Spannagel Cave come first, with the Ahornspitze peak nearby; three hours is typically enough, and June to August suits it best.

gem:achensee.text: Achensee is an alpine lake in Austria, calm and family friendly, ringed by mountains. Schloss Tratzberg and the Achenseekraftwerk come first among the sights, with Hochiss and Sonnjoch nearby; seven hours suits a full visit, best from June through August.

gem:la-rhune.text: La Rhune is a mountain village in France, a family favorite and something of a regional icon. Larrun peak and Abbadia Castle head the sights, with Pheasant Island and the Grottes de Sare nearby; four hours is typical, best in July or August.

gem:falasarna.text: Falasarna is a beach and coastal area in Greece, layered with history. Balos Lagoon and the ruins of Phalasarna are the highlight, with Chrysoskalitissa Monastery close by; four hours covers it, best in April, May, June or September.

gem:matala.text: Matala is a beach village in Greece layered with ancient history. The Palace of Phaistos and Hagia Triada lead the sights, with Gortyn also within reach; three hours covers a visit, best in April or May.

gem:methoni.text: Methoni is a medieval castle town on the coast of Greece, in Messenia. Methoni Castle is the main draw, with Voidokilia beach nearby for a swim; two hours is enough for the castle itself, best in April or May, and public transport here is limited.

gem:petra-tou-romiou.text: Petra tou Romiou is an iconic beach and coastal area in Cyprus, rich with ancient history. Paphos Castle and the Tombs of the Kings come first, with the Paphos Archaeological Park nearby; four hours is enough, best from May through September.

gem:bassano-del-grappa.text: Bassano del Grappa is a historic town in Italy known for food and its landmark bridge. Ponte degli Alpini draws the most visitors, with Villa Godi and Mount Grappa filling out a six-hour visit, best in May, June, July or September.

gem:are-sweden.text: Are is a mountain village in Sweden built for skiing and summer trails alike. Areskutan peak and the Are Old Church come first on most visits, with Tannforsen waterfall and Aresjon lake nearby; two hours covers the village itself, best in July.

gem:kalmar.text: Kalmar is a historic castle city in Sweden, on the coast. Kalmar slott and Kalmar Cathedral come first among the sights, with the Oland Bridge and Kalmar Konstmuseum nearby; six hours suits a full visit, best from June through August.

gem:hel-peninsula.text: Hel Peninsula is a narrow strip of beach and coast in Poland, popular for surfing and family trips. The Gora Szwedow Lighthouse marks the tip, and Battle of Hel history runs through the area; six hours covers it well, best from June through August.

gem:bucaco.text: Bucaco Forest is a quiet, wooded village in Portugal, good for slow walks among the trees. The Old Cathedral of Coimbra and Monastery of Santa Cruz sit nearby for a longer day; three hours suits the forest itself, best in May, June or September.

gem:peniche.text: Peniche is a fortress town on the coast of Portugal, known for surfing. The Berlengas islands stand out first, with Berlenga Grande Island and its lighthouse a boat ride away; five hours is enough for the town, and June through August suits it best.

gem:sao-martinho-do-porto.text: Sao Martinho do Porto is a quiet, family beach town in Portugal. The Sanctuary of Our Lady of Nazare, Alcobaca Monastery and Igreja de Sao Giao sit nearby for a longer day; two hours suits the beach itself, and June through August draws the most visitors.

gem:aljezur.text: Aljezur is a surf village in Portugal ringed by castle ruins and beach coves. Praia da Arrifana and the Fort of Arrifana head the sights, with Foia peak in the Serra de Monchique nearby; three hours covers the highlights, best in May, June or September.

gem:valenca.text: Valenca is a fortress town in Portugal, one of several places sharing the name. Tui Cathedral across the border and Monte Aloia lead a visit, with Praia de Samil nearby; six hours takes in the walls and the views, with June through August the season to pick.

gem:prohodna.text: Prohodna is a remote nature town in Bulgaria, part of a UNESCO Global Geopark. Prohodna Cave is the highlight, with the Karlukovski karst and Samuilitsa nearby; four hours covers a visit, best in April, May, June, September or October.

gem:bachkovo.text: Bachkovo Monastery is a historic mountain site in Bulgaria, on the UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List. Asen's Fortress and the Church of St John the Baptist lead the sights, with Asenovgrad nearby; eight hours covers it, best in May, June or September.

gem:madara-rider.text: Madara is a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Bulgaria, quiet and steeped in history. The Madara Rider heads the sights, with Shumen Fortress and the Tombul Mosque nearby in Shumen; four hours covers the site, best in May, June or September.

gem:siurana.text: Siurana is a medieval village in Spain, perched for climbers and wine lovers alike. Santa Maria de Siurana and the reservoir below anchor a visit, with Poblet Monastery further out; four hours covers the village, best in May, June or September.

gem:el-rocio.text: El Rocio is a countryside village in Spain on the edge of Donana National Park. Almonte and Hinojos sit nearby, with the Hermitage of El Rocio at the center of village life; four hours is typical, best in April or May.

gem:mojacar.text: Mojacar is a coastal village in Spain, known today as a beach resort. The Iglesia de Santa Maria and Castillo de las Escobetas get the most attention, with Castillo de Macenas nearby; two hours covers the highlights, best in April, May, June or September.

gem:north-berwick.text: North Berwick is a coastal town in East Lothian, Scotland. Tantallon Castle and Bass Rock lead the way, with the Scottish Seabird Centre and Fidra Lighthouse nearby; four hours covers the highlights, best from June to August.

gem:sandwood-bay.text: Sandwood Bay is a remote wilderness beach in the United Kingdom. Am Buachaille and Handa Island stand out first, with Ben Stack and Smoo Cave nearby; four hours suits a visit, and June through August is easiest for travel.

gem:wells-somerset.text: Wells is a historic market town in the United Kingdom, built around its cathedral. Wells Cathedral draws the most attention, with Glastonbury Abbey and Glastonbury Tor nearby; six hours covers it, best from June through September.

gem:clonmacnoise.text: Clonmacnoise is a medieval monastic site in Ireland, quiet and steeped in history. Clonfert Cathedral and Moydrum Castle lie further afield, with the Clonfinlough Stone and River Suck nearby; three hours covers the ruins, best from June to August.

gem:achmelvich.text: Achmelvich is a remote wilderness beach in the United Kingdom, framed by mountains and open water. Suilven and the Summer Isles lead the view, with Ardvreck Castle and Loch Assynt close by; four hours suits a visit, and June through August works best.

gem:cheddar-gorge.text: Cheddar Gorge is a countryside nature area in the United Kingdom. Gough's Cave and Wookey Hole Caves head the sights, with Bristol Cathedral and Glastonbury Abbey further out; seven hours covers the gorge and Mendip Hills, best from June through September.

gem:llangollen.text: Llangollen is a small countryside town in the United Kingdom, on the historic road toward Wrexham. Pontcysyllte Aqueduct is the main draw, with Castell Dinas Bran and Valle Crucis Abbey nearby; three hours takes in the town, and June through August works best.

gem:malin-head.text: Malin Head is a remote coastal wilderness area in Ireland. Fort Dunree and Carrickabraghy Castle lead the sights, with Inishtrahull Island and the Urris Hills nearby; four hours suits a visit, best from June to September.

gem:benbulbin-sligo.text: Sligo is a coastal town in Ireland ringed by mountains. Ben Bulben comes first, then Truskmore, Lough Gill and Knocknarea, about four hours in all. Transport is poor, so plan a car for June through September.

gem:cres-lubenice.text: Cres is a quiet island off Croatia, its coast lined with villages. Krk and Plavnik open the sights, and Lake Vrana sits inland, with Paradise Beach not far off. May to August is the season, though transport stays limited.

gem:pag-island.text: Pag Island lies off Croatia, prized for beaches and food. Pag town leads the sights, with Velebit behind it and Olib, Silba and Vir reachable by boat. Zrce and Kraljicina plaza draw crowds in May and June.

gem:stari-bar.text: Stari Bar is a fortress village in Montenegro, quiet and historic. Lake Skadar and Rumija fill the view, and the Bar Aqueduct and Ratac Abbey round out about three hours. Transport runs well; May or June suits it best.

gem:saranda.text: Sarande sits on the coast of Albania, built around its beaches. Butrint leads the sights, with Onchesmos and the Ksamil Islets close by, about four hours in total. Sunset Beach draws people in April and May.

gem:brezovica.text: Brezovica is a mountain village in Kosovo built for skiing and hiking. The Sar Mountains and the Brezovica Ski Resort anchor it, with the Sinan Pasha Mosque a detour into nearby Prizren. Transport is poor, so bring a car from June to September.

gem:windermere.text: Windermere is a village in Cumbria set beside its lake. The Lake District and Scafell Pike lead the sights, with Coniston Water and Helvellyn close by. June through August is best, though transport stays poor.

gem:angouleme.text: Angouleme is a cathedral town in France known for its art. Angouleme Cathedral tops the list, then the Musee d'Angouleme and the Chateau d'Angouleme, about six hours total. Transport is good; May through September suits it best.

gem:viterbo.text: Viterbo is a cathedral town in Italy with a walled, medieval core. Villa Lante and the Gardens of Bomarzo come first, then Viterbo Cathedral, roughly six hours total. Lake Vico sits nearby; May or June is best.

gem:henley-on-thames.text: Henley-on-Thames is a market town in England set along the Thames. Chiltern Hills and Madejski Stadium lead the way, then Reading Abbey and Greys Court, six hours total. June through September suits it best.

gem:bridgwater.text: Bridgwater is a market town in Somerset built around its history. The Sweet Track comes first, then the Somerset Brick and Tile Museum and the Admiral Blake Museum, about six hours running. Best from June to September.

gem:great-malvern.text: Great Malvern is a market town in the United Kingdom shaped by the hills around it. Worcester Cathedral and the Malvern Hills anchor a six-hour circuit, with Great Malvern Priory added in. June through September is best.

gem:blois.text: Blois is a city in France on the edge of the Loire Valley. The Chateau de Blois and the Chateau de Beauregard headline it, Blois Cathedral filling the rest of ten hours. May through September works well.

gem:settle.text: Settle is a market village in the Yorkshire Dales, ringed by hills. Whernside and Pen-y-ghent lead the sights, with Skipton Castle filling out about three hours. Transport is poor, so June through August with a car works best.

gem:kirkby-stephen.text: Kirkby Stephen is a market village in the United Kingdom, quiet and topped by a ruined castle. Pendragon Castle and Verterae lead the sights, with Cauldron Snout and Cautley Spout adding waterfalls. June to August suits it best.

gem:natzwiller.text: Natzwiller is a small village in France carrying a European Heritage Label. Chateau du Haut-Koenigsbourg and Champ du Feu come first, then Mont Sainte-Odile, roughly three hours total. Best used June through September.

gem:newark-on-trent.text: Newark on Trent is a market town in the United Kingdom known for its castle. Southwell Minster and the Battle of Stoke Field top the list, then St Giles' Church, about six hours in all. June through September fits best.

gem:tortosa.text: Tortosa is a historic town in Spain near Tarragona. Tortosa Cathedral comes first, then Mont Caro, Creu de Santos and La Moleta, six hours to see them. April and May suit it best, with Bassa de les Olles nearby.

gem:huntingdon.text: Huntingdon is a market town in Cambridgeshire linked to Oliver Cromwell. The Cromwell Museum and Kimbolton Castle come first, then Houghton Mill, roughly six hours total. Best from June to September.

gem:lytham-st-annes.text: Lytham St Annes is a coastal town in England made up of three smaller towns. Blackpool Tower and Blackpool Zoo lead the sights nearby, with the Pleasure Beach Resort close by. June through August suits the beach best.

gem:tortona.text: Tortona is a historic town in Italy centered on its cathedral. Tortona Cathedral tops the list, then the Shrine of Nostra Signora della Guardia, about four hours in all. Transport is poor, so bring a car in April, May, June or September.

gem:meiningen.text: Meiningen is a historic town in Germany built around its churches and theatre. St Bartholomew's Church and Schloss Landsberg anchor a six-hour circuit, with the Meininger Staatstheater added in. Best used June through September.

gem:carmarthen.text: Carmarthen is a market town in South Wales ringed by castles. Carmarthen Castle and the National Botanic Garden of Wales come first, then Kidwelly Castle further out, six hours total. June through August suits it best.

gem:requena.text: Requena is a historic town in Spain west of Valencia. The Iglesia del Salvador and the Iglesia de Santa Maria come first, then the medieval Barri de la Vila, roughly five hours total. April, May or September works best.

gem:autun.text: Autun is a walled hill town in France layered with Roman history. Autun Cathedral and the Porte d'Arroux top the list, then the Roman Theatre of Augustodunum, about six hours in all. Best from June to September.

gem:viseu.text: Viseu is a hilltop city in central Portugal with nine hours worth of sights. Viseu Cathedral and the Igreja da Misericordia lead the way, followed by the Grao Vasco National Museum. May and June bring the best weather.

gem:savennieres.text: Savennieres is a small village in France near Angers. The Chateau de Brissac and Angers Cathedral come first, then Angers Bridge, roughly three hours total. May through September with a car suits it best.

gem:todi.text: Todi is a hill town in Umbria overlooking the Tiber. Santa Maria della Consolazione comes first, then the Concattedrale della Santissima Annunziata, five hours in all. May, June or September suits it best.

gem:busteni.text: Busteni sits in the Carpathian Mountains in Romania, the gateway to the Bucegi range. Sinaia and Peles Castle top the list, then Omu Peak and Caraiman Peak rising above, about six hours in all. Best from June to September.

gem:pirot-centralni-trg.text: Pirot Centralni Trg is a historic square in Serbia surrounded by nature. The Church of the Nativity of Christ tops the list, then Pilj Waterfall and Zavoj Lake, about four hours in all. Best visited May, June or September.

gem:trollhattan.text: Trollhattan is an industrial town in Sweden built around its waterfall. Trollhattan Falls and the Saab Car Museum anchor a six-hour circuit, with the Trollhattan Shia Mosque added in. June through August brings the best weather.

gem:casale-monferrato.text: Casale Monferrato is a historic town in Italy known for its synagogue. The Synagogue of Casale Monferrato comes first, then Sacro Monte di Crea, six hours total. April through June or September works best.

gem:luxeuil-les-bains.text: Luxeuil-les-Bains is a historic town in France once built around its abbey. Luxeuil Abbey comes first, then the Hotel Thiadot and the Tour des echevins, about five hours running. Best from June to September.

gem:malborghetto.text: Malborghetto is a small village in Italy set among national park peaks. Jof di Montasio and Jof Fuart come first, then Mangart, roughly three hours total. Transport is poor, so bring a car from May through August.

gem:selestat.text: Selestat sits in the middle of Alsace, a historic town built around its churches and castles. The Chateau du Haut-Koenigsbourg and the Humanist Library come first, six hours in all. May through September fits best.

gem:kristianstad.text: Kristianstad is a town in Scania in southern Sweden, part of a biosphere reserve. Trinity Church and Backaskog Castle anchor a six-hour circuit, with Kristianstad's Railway Museum added in. Best visited June through August.

gem:crest.text: Crest is a historic town in France topped by its tower. The Tour de Crest comes first, then the Eglise Saint-Sauveur de Crest, about five hours running. Best in May, June or September.

gem:radom.text: Radom is a city in Mazowieckie, Poland, with ten hours worth of sights for those who look. The Holy Family church and the Roman Catholic Diocese of Radom lead the way. May through September suits it best.

gem:alise-sainte-reine.text: Alise-Sainte-Reine is a small village in France tied to ancient Alesia. The Abbey of Fontenay and the Vercingetorix Monument come first, roughly three hours total. Best from June through September.

gem:saint-nectaire.text: Saint-Nectaire is a small village in the Massif Central in France. The Eglise de Saint-Nectaire tops the list, then Puy de Dome and Puy de Sancy rising close behind, about three hours in all. Best from June to September.

gem:campulung.text: Campulung is an area in Romania known for its cathedral and nature. The Mausoleum of Mateias and Namaesti Monastery lead the sights, with Castra Jidava close by, best from May to September across about five hours.

gem:haderslev.text: Haderslev is a cathedral town in Denmark with a historic centre. Haderslev Cathedral anchors the sights, and Haderslev Dam, Barso and Kalvo add lake and island scenery, reachable by good transport across six hours from June to August.

gem:rewal.text: Rewal is a beach village in Poland known for its coastal ruins. The Ruins of the church in Trzesacz and Trzesacz Palace lead the sights, with Latarnia Morska Niechorze along the shore, best June to August in about three hours despite poor transport.

gem:bueu.text: Bueu is a coastal town in Spain facing the Atlantic Islands of Galicia National Park. Cies Islands and Ons Island headline the sights, with Rande Bridge and Isla Tambo nearby, best June through August over about six hours, transport limited.

gem:malinska.text: Malinska is a beach village on Krk in Croatia, with a cathedral in its historic core. Krk Bridge, Cres and Plavnik fill a short two-hour visit best from May to August, though transport is poor.

gem:pazin.text: Pazin, a historic village in Croatia, is anchored by Pazin Castle. Dvigrad and Via Flavia add depth, with Zarecki krov and Vojak nearby, manageable in about two hours between June and August, though transport is poor.

gem:sint-truiden.text: Sint-Truiden is a cathedral town in Belgium with a long art and history trail. Sint-Truiden Abbey and Sint-Agnesbegijnhof lead the sights, and Zoutleeuw and Torenburcht round out about six hours, best from May to September, with good transport.

gem:baska.text: Baska is a beach village on Krk in Croatia with a small cathedral quarter. Goli otok and Sveti Grgur sit offshore, and Plavnik and Obzova complete a two-hour loop, best from May through July, though transport stays poor.

gem:bergun.text: Bergun is a historic village in Switzerland known for art and its cathedral. The Landwasser Viaduct and Piz Mitgel headline, while Gletscher Ducan and Julier Pass sit further out, fillable in about four hours from June to August despite poor transport.

gem:chernomorets.text: Chernomorets is a beach village in Bulgaria along the Black Sea coastline. Battle of Skafida and Lake Burgas anchor a three-hour visit, best in May, June or September, though transport is poor.

gem:hokksund.text: Hokksund is a nature area in Norway with historic and artistic sides. Vikersundbakken and Drammen Bridge lead the sights, and Eikeren and Ypsilon round out about six hours, best in June or July, with good transport.

gem:levoca.text: Levoca layers art onto a historic town in Slovakia. Spis Castle and St Martin's Cathedral headline, with the Church of Holy Spirit and Marianska hora nearby, comfortable in about four hours between June and September.

gem:sever-do-vouga.text: Sever do Vouga is a nature area in Portugal with historic and cathedral sides. The Castle of Santa Maria da Feira and Serra do Caramulo lead a five-hour visit, with Estadio Municipal de Aveiro and the Church of Sao Salvador nearby, best in May or June.

gem:varybobi.text: Varybobi is a historic village in Greece near well-known ancient sights. The Acropolis Museum, Areopagus and Temple of Olympian Zeus sit nearby, along with Panathenaic Stadium and the Tower of the Winds, worth about three hours in May or September.

gem:zutphen.text: Zutphen, a historic town in the Netherlands, blends art and cathedral heritage. Martinikerk and Lebuinuskerk anchor the old streets, and Berkelpoort extends a six-hour visit, best May through September, with good transport.

gem:drobak.text: Drobak is a coastal town in Norway mixing art with history. Oscarsborg Fortress and the Vebjorn Sand Da Vinci Project lead, with Tusenfryd and Haoya adding a five-hour day, best June to August, though transport runs limited.

gem:montalegre.text: Montalegre is a castle area in Portugal set among wild nature. Castelo de Montalegre and the Geres Mountains dominate, with Aquis Querquennis and the Church of Santa Comba de Bande nearby, filling about five hours from June to September.

gem:ehenbichl.text: Ehenbichl is a castle village in Austria near Zugspitze. Neuschwanstein Castle and Hohenschwangau Castle draw most visitors, and Reutte Friary adds a stop, fillable in about four hours between June and August, though transport is poor.

gem:oirschot.text: Oirschot is a historic town in the Netherlands with a strong cathedral heritage. Sint-Josephkerk and Koningshoeven Abbey anchor the sights, while Van Abbemuseum and Safaripark Beekse Bergen round out six hours, best from May to September.

gem:portel.text: Portel is a castle area in Portugal rich in nature and art. Castle of Portel and Castle of Alvito headline, with Castle of Valongo and Ponte romana sobre a Ribeira de Odivelas nearby, best in April or May over about four hours.

gem:poysdorf.text: Poysdorf is a castle village in Austria bordering protected landscape. Mikulov Castle and the Palava Protected Landscape Area lead the sights, with Leiser Berge nearby, fillable in about four hours from May to September, though transport is poor.

gem:atzara.text: Atzara counts among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia, a village in Italy built around Nuraghe Nolza and Nuraghe Lo. Chiesa di Sant'Antioco and its modern art museum add variety, all reachable in about two hours across May, June and September.

gem:pontivy.text: Pontivy stands among Les Plus Beaux Detours de France, a historic town in France. Chapelle Notre-Dame-de-Quelven and Eglise Saint-Joseph de Pontivy lead the churches, with Lake Guerledan close by, worth about five hours between June and September.

gem:eu.text: Eu is a historic town in France recognized among Les Plus Beaux Detours de France. Chateau d'Eu leads the sights, with Notre-Dame et Saint-Laurent and Eglise Saint-Pierre d'Ault nearby, worth about six hours from June to August.

gem:nogent-le-rotrou.text: Nogent-le-Rotrou is a historic town in France honored among Les Plus Beaux Detours de France. The chateau Saint-Jean and Eglise Saint-Hilaire de Nogent-le-Rotrou headline, with Abbaye Saint-Denis nearby, worth about five hours from June to September.

gem:bernay.text: Bernay is a historic town in France, part of the Villes et Pays d'art et d'histoire network. Abbaye Notre-Dame de Bernay and Basilique Notre-Dame de la Couture anchor the sights, with Menhir du Croc nearby, worth about five hours from June to September.

gem:atina.text: Atina holds a place among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia, a village in Italy lined with palazzi. Palazzo Ducale and Palazzo Sipari anchor the center, with Chiesa di Santa Maria Assunta nearby, easy to see in about three hours across May, June and September.

gem:novara-di-sicilia.text: Novara di Sicilia is a historic village in Italy watched over by Rocca Novara. The ancient site of Abacaenum rewards a short stop, and the Duomo di Novara di Sicilia anchors about two hours, best kept to May or June.

gem:savignano-irpino.text: Savignano Irpino is a village in Italy circled by the Aequum Tuticum site. La Starza and Crepacore castle preserve its layers of history, and Monte del Niglio closes out about two hours, best in May or June.

gem:la-fleche.text: La Fleche ranks among Les Plus Beaux Detours de France, a historic town in France built around the Prytanee National Militaire. Chateau de Bazouges adds texture, with the Chapelle Notre-Dame des Vertus nearby, worth about five hours from May to September.

gem:bassano-in-teverina.text: Bassano in Teverina joins I Borghi piu belli d'Italia, a village in Italy centered on Immacolata Concezione and Santa Maria Assunta. Santa Maria dei Lumi and nearby Orte round out about three hours, best across April, May, June or September.

gem:montecassiano.text: Montecassiano is one of I Borghi piu belli d'Italia, sitting a short ride from Macerata in Italy. Palazzo Buonaccorsi and Palazzo Compagnoni Marefoschi hold the village center, while Arena Sferisterio lies beyond it, filling about three hours in May or June.

gem:opi.text: Opi is a village in Italy opening onto Val Fondillo and Camosciara. Valle Cervara and Monte Marsicano add wilder ground, and Lago di Barrea sits close by, worth about three hours between June and August.

gem:badolato.text: Badolato is a village in Italy above Mimosa Beach. Torre Sant'Antonio and the Museum of Calabrian Folk Music Instruments fill about two hours, and Isca lies within reach, best in May or June.

gem:bovino.text: Bovino figures among I Borghi piu belli d'Italia, a village in Italy watched over by Mount Crispiniano. The Concattedrale di Santa Maria Assunta anchors about two hours, with Cantine Cerrato nearby, best in May, June or September.

gem:meymac.text: Meymac is a village in France built around its own abbey beside the market Halle. Lac de la Triouzoune offers a swim after the two hours the old town takes. It connects easily, best visited June through September.

gem:joinville.text: Joinville, a Petites Cites de Caractere holder in France, opens with the Chateau du Grand Jardin. The old ironworks at Fonderie du Val d'Osne and the Abbaye de Saint-Urbain round out three hours. Transport is easy, best done June through September.

gem:chilhac.text: Few villages this size carry a working priory, but Chilhac does, centered on the Prieure de Lavoute-Chilhac. The ruined Chateau de Saint-Ilpize nearby makes an easy three hours together. June through September brings the best weather here.

gem:montbrun-les-bains.text: Montbrun-les-Bains, one of the Les Plus Beaux Villages de France, sits below Mont Ventoux. Brantes and the ruined Chateau d'Aulan round out three hours with the village church. May or June beats high summer, since transport runs thin.

gem:tournemire.text: Tournemire, one of the Les Plus Beaux Villages de France, looks toward the Plomb du Cantal. Its church of Saint-Jean-Baptiste and the nearby Chateau de Sedaiges fill three unhurried hours. June to August works best, given thin transport.

gem:vic-sur-seille.text: Vic-sur-Seille built its Petites Cites de Caractere reputation around the old Hotel de la Monnaie. The Couvent des Carmes and the enceinte of nearby Marsal round out three hours, Lindre lake close by after. Good connections favor May through September.

gem:saint-savinien.text: Saint-Savinien holds the Petites Cites de Caractere designation in France, centered on the Chateau de la Roche Courbon. Its parish churches at Champdolent and Romegoux round out three hours nearby. It connects easily, favoring May through September.

gem:menet.text: Menet keeps its Petites Cites de Caractere status around a single parish church. Lac de Bort-les-Orgues lies close by, alongside smaller churches at Antignac and Chastel-Marlhac. The village takes about three hours, best between June and September.

gem:mauleon.text: Two ruined castles define Mauleon, a Petites Cites de Caractere site in France: the Chateau de Mauleon and the Chateau de la Durbeliere. The Manoir de Saint-Jouin fills out a two-hour visit. Lac de Ribou is close after, best reached June through September.

gem:lavardens.text: Lavardens, one of the Les Plus Beaux Villages de France, is built around the Chateau de Lavardens. The nearby Pile gallo-romaine de Saint-Lary adds a stop, and two hours covers it. May, June, September or October suit it best, service being thin.

gem:la-mothe-saint-heray.text: La Mothe-Saint-Heray, a Petites Cites de Caractere village in France, is known for its cluster of tumuli, labeled Tumulus A through E. The church of Saint-Maixent in nearby Pamproux adds a stop. Its three hours suit May through September best.

gem:altrincham.text: Dunham Massey Hall is the leading sight in Altrincham, a historic market town in the United Kingdom. Baguley Hall and Tatton Hall extend the day, and six hours covers the main stops. June through August is the easiest window, with regular services.

gem:tourtour.text: Tourtour, ranked among the Les Plus Beaux Villages de France, is built around the old Commanderie du Ruou. The Chapelle Notre-Dame de Speluque and the Abbaye de Florieyes fill three quiet hours. May or June is easier here, since access is limited.

gem:saint-symphorien-sur-coise.text: Saint-Symphorien-sur-Coise, under the Les Plus Beaux Detours de France label, is built around its own hat museum. The parish church and the old Porte de Riverie gate add another stop nearby. Two hours covers it well, best between June and September.

gem:sille-le-guillaume.text: A castle gives Sille-le-Guillaume its name, at the center of this Petites Cites de Caractere village. The Abbaye de Champagne and the church of Notre-Dame add a stop nearby. Two hours suits a visit, best in June through September.

gem:luche-pringe.text: The Chateau du Lude is the main reason to stop in Luche-Pringe, a Petites Cites de Caractere village in France. The old Moulin de Merve and the Manoir de Venevelles round out three hours. Good connections make May through September easy to plan around.

gem:ecouche.text: Argentan Abbey stands closest to Ecouche, a Petites Cites de Caractere village in France. The Hotel du comte de Lonlay and churches at Habloville and Vaux-le-Bardoult round out three hours. June to September suits travel best here.

gem:riverie.text: Riverie, a Petites Cites de Caractere village in France, is home to the Aqueduc romain and the old Marrel factories. The Chapelle Saint-Vincent and the bridge over the Dureze add another stop. Its three hours suit June through September best.

gem:sandbach.text: Little Moreton Hall leads a run of manor houses around Sandbach, a market town in the United Kingdom, including Brereton Hall and Crewe Hall. Six hours covers the group at an easy pace. June through August works best for a visit.

gem:hungerford.text: Ramsbury Manor and the grounds around it give Hungerford, a historic market town in the United Kingdom, its main draw. St Mary's Church and West Woodhay House fill out a three-hour visit. It connects well, so June through September is the easiest time to come.

gem:hythe.text: Hythe sits close enough to Folkestone to take in its Roman Villa and castle in the same day. Leas Cliff Hall and the Kent Battle of Britain Museum round out six hours in this historic market town. Transport into town is simple, best in July and August.

gem:billericay.text: Ingatestone Hall and the village of Ingatestone give Billericay, a market town in the United Kingdom, its main stop. Thorndon Hall and the woodland at Norsey Wood add to a six-hour day. June through September is easiest, with frequent connections.

gem:somerton.text: Somerton, a small village in the United Kingdom under the old market-town label, has the Strode Theatre as an unusual anchor. Walton and Ivythorn Hills and the Battle of Langport site fill four hours. Transport serves it well, best June through September.

gem:mouzon.text: Mouzon centers on its own Monastere and the Maisons espagnoles, a Petites Cites de Caractere village in France. Carignan, nearby, adds its fortifications and Eglise Notre-Dame for a longer day. Mouzon takes three hours on its own, best June through September.

gem:frodsham.text: Halton Castle and the Silver Jubilee Bridge overlook Frodsham, a historic market town in the United Kingdom. Norton Priory and the village of Helsby extend the day to about six hours. June through August is easiest, with steady connections.

gem:tenterden.text: Great Maytham Hall and Smallhythe Place anchor Tenterden, a historic market town in the United Kingdom. Rolvenden Windmill and Horne's Place Chapel round out a three-hour visit nearby. It is easy to reach, best done June through August.

gem:murat.text: Murat sits below the Plomb du Cantal, the Puy de Seycheuse rising behind this Petites Cites de Caractere village. Saint-Pierre de Bredons and the Chateau d'Anterroches fill three hours. June through August suits it best, access being simple.

gem:stokesley.text: The ruins of Whorlton Castle lead the way into Stokesley, a market town in the United Kingdom. Rudby Hall, Busby Hall and the walk along Langbaurgh Ridge fill out three hours. June through August is best, and reaching Stokesley is straightforward.

gem:worth.text: All Saints' Church leads a run of sights around Worth, in the United Kingdom, including Walmer Castle and Richborough Castle. St Augustine's Cross and the tidal pool at Walpole Bay round out four hours. Transport is dependable, best July and August.

gem:aubagne.text: Aubagne, a town in France, is built around the French Foreign Legion Museum. Cassis and its coves at Port-Pin and En-Vau lie within reach, alongside the Chapelle des Penitents noirs. Six hours covers Aubagne, best kept for April, May or September.

gem:sarzana.text: Two fortresses define Sarzana, a town in Italy: the Fortezza Firmafede and the Fortezza Castracani. The Castello Malaspina and Palazzo Roderio add to a full six-hour day. May through August is easiest, with connections holding up well.

gem:grado.text: The Basilica of Sant'Eufemia and its old Baptistry give Grado, a village in Italy, its center. The Marano-Grado Lagoon lies close by, past the Basilica di Santa Maria della Grazie, in two unhurried hours. Transport is reliable, suiting May through August.

gem:omegna.text: Omegna sits near Lake Orta, below the peak of Mottarone, a town in Italy. The Sacro Monte di Orta and the old Broletto lead a five-hour visit, with Lago di Mergozzo a short trip further. It connects easily, favoring June through August.

gem:montevarchi.text: The Museo Paleontologico is the most distinctive stop in Montevarchi, a town in Italy. The Casa Masaccio gallery, the Palazzo Pretorio and the Roseto botanico Carla Fineschi fill six hours. May, June or September are the easiest months to visit.

VDE.text: El Hierro, an island in Spain, marks its far point with the Punta Orchilla Lighthouse. Pico de Malpaso and Tanganasoga rise inland, and Valverde anchors about four hours of stops. Transport is limited, so allow extra time June through September.

gem:mikulov.text: Mikulov is a wine village in South Moravia, Czechia, capped by its castle. Mikulov Castle and Na Turoldu are the draw, with Palava Protected Landscape Area within reach for hiking; worth about four hours, May through September.

gem:skagen.text: Skagen is a quiet coastal village in Denmark, known for artists and wide beaches. Grenen and the Skagen Fyr lighthouse come first, with Den Tilsandede Kirke a short walk further; best kept to July or August, over about three hours.

gem:pocitelj.text: Pocitelj is a small Ottoman fortress village in Bosnia and Herzegovina, quiet and historic. Kravica falls and the town of Mostar make good nearby stops; three hours cover the village itself, best in May, June or September.

gem:echternach.text: Echternach and the Mullerthal forest sit in Luxembourg, built around an old abbey. Fraubillenkreuz and the Prumerburg ruins anchor the local sights, with the Porta Nigra and Cathedral of Trier a short trip away; reckon on four hours, May through September.

gem:makarska.text: Makarska is a beach town on the coast of Croatia, backed by the Biokovo range. Sveti Jure summit and Park prirode Biokovo top the list, with the Sveti Ilija Tunnel just beyond; most visitors give it four hours, in May or June.

gem:namur.text: Namur is a historic fortress city in Belgium, known for being affordable to visit. The Citadel of Namur and Belfry of Namur dominate the skyline, with Abbaye de Floreffe and Hospice Saint-Gilles nearby; a full day is worth it, May through September.

gem:sozopol.text: Sozopol is a small coastal town on the Bulgarian coastline of the Black Sea. Its old quarter overlooks the water, with the offshore islands a common day trip; three hours is typical, in May, June or September.

gem:alba-iulia.text: Alba Iulia is a baroque fortress city in Romania, seat of a historic citadel. The Batthyaneum Library and Coronation Cathedral are the highlights, with the 1 Decembrie 1918 University nearby; the season runs May, June and September, about seven hours.

gem:derry.text: Derry is a historic city in the United Kingdom, ringed by its old walls. Grianan of Aileach and the Guildhall start most visits, with St Columb's Cathedral a few minutes across town; a full day covers it, June through August.

gem:carvoeiro.text: Carvoeiro is a small beach town on the coast of Portugal, quiet outside summer. Praia da Marinha and Praia de Benagil are the main draw, with Praia da Rocha a short drive away; the visit runs about six hours, May through September.

gem:gallipoli-puglia.text: Gallipoli is a baroque beach town in Puglia, Italy, wrapped around a small harbour. The old town and Grotta del Cavallo set the scene, with Spiaggia della Purita just along the shore; come in May or June, when three hours is enough.

gem:millau.text: Millau is a small town in France, known for its viaduct over the valley. The Millau Viaduct headlines the sights, with La Graufesenque and Compeyre not far off; it takes about six hours, best June, July or September.

gem:vlieland.text: Vlieland is a quiet, remote island in the Netherlands. Vuurduin dune and the Museum Tromp's Huys open the visit, with the beach at Vliehors further along the coast; June to September is the season, worth about six hours.

gem:camp-adventure-tower.text: Camp Adventure Forest Tower is a family attraction in Denmark, built around a treetop tower. Bregentved and BonBon-Land round out a visit nearby, with Fakse a short trip further; June, July and August suit it best, in about three hours.

gem:rabjerg-mile.text: Rabjerg Mile is a shifting sand dune in Denmark, near the town of Skagen. The Skagen Lighthouse and Skagen Church make an easy add-on, with Hulsig Church further along; two hours cover the dune itself, best in July or August.

gem:ameland.text: Ameland is a low, sandy island in the Netherlands. Natuurcentrum Ameland and the dunes come first for most visitors, with the Engelsmanplaat sandbar just offshore; plan on seven hours, June through August.

gem:edam-volendam.text: Edam and Volendam are historic villages in the Netherlands, set along the Markermeer and IJmeer. The Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam make an easy day trip; June, July and August work best, at about four hours.

gem:alkmaar.text: Alkmaar is known for food and its old center, a historic city in the Netherlands. Abdij van Egmond and the Stedelijk Museum Alkmaar are worth the morning, with Hortus Bulborum on the edge of town; a full day is worth it, June through August.

gem:la-roche-en-ardenne.text: La Roche-en-Ardenne is a small castle town in Belgium, set in the Ardennes. Le Chesle and Le Herou reward a stop, with Lake Nisramont a short drive on; two hours cover the town, best June through September.

gem:ostend.text: Ostend is a coastal art city in Belgium, its promenade lined with beaches. The Ensorhuis and Sint-Petrus-en-Pauluskerk get top billing, with Klein Strand and the Spuikom a few streets on; the season runs June through August, over about ten hours.

gem:pernstejn.text: Pernstejn Castle is a fairytale medieval castle in Czechia, quiet and little visited. Bobruvka and Sykor trails mark the walks nearby, with Svabuv kopec within walking range; reckon on four hours, June through September.

gem:znojmo.text: Znojmo is a wine town in South Moravia, Czechia, wrapped around its castle. The Ducal Rotunda and Znojmo Castle anchor the old town, with Podyji National Park just outside town; the visit runs about six hours, May through September.

gem:stramberk.text: Stramberk is a fairytale village in Czechia, topped by an old tower. Sipka cave and the birth house of Sigmund Freud are the reason to stop, with Sostyn a short climb on; it takes about four hours, best June through August.

gem:banska-bystrica.text: Banska Bystrica is a historic mountain city in Slovakia, ringed by peaks. The wooden articular church of Hronsek and Badinsky prales stand out among the sights, with Nemce further along the valley; plan on nine hours, May through September.

gem:gyor.text: Gyor is a baroque food city in Hungary, its old town full of monuments. The Cathedral Basilica of the Assumption of Our Lady and Arrabona take pride of place, with the National Theatre of Gyor nearby; come in May, June or September, eight hours covers it.

gem:fischland-darss.text: Fischland-Darss-Zingst is a quiet coastal area in Germany, backed by a national park. Darss forest and the Natureum are the main stops, with Barther Oie and Weststrand beach further down the coast; best kept to June through August, over about three hours.

gem:trift-bridge.text: Trift Bridge is a high suspension crossing in Switzerland, reached on foot. Finsteraarhorn and the Rhonegletscher glacier rise nearby, with Furka Pass and Grimsel Pass close by; the crossing is best seen June to August, over roughly seven hours.

gem:fribourg.text: Fribourg is a quiet medieval town in Switzerland, home to its own university. The University of Fribourg and Espace Jean-Tinguely-Niki-de-Saint-Phalle share the spotlight, with Lake Murten a stone's throw away; worth about six hours, June through September.

gem:grimentz.text: Grimentz is a romantic alpine village in Switzerland, quiet under the Dent Blanche peak. Vissoie and Ayer make easy stops nearby, with Bella Tola and Sasseneire rising above; reckon on three hours, June through August.

gem:mittenwald.text: Mittenwald is a historic alpine village in Germany, framed by the Karwendel range. Zugspitze and the Westliche Karwendelspitze tower over the village, with Hochwanner and the Bergiselschanze just behind; it takes about three hours, best June through August.

gem:gmunden.text: Gmunden is a lakeside castle town in Austria, quiet along the Traunsee shore. Seeschloss Ort and Schloss Cumberland sit at the center of a visit, with the Traunstein peak close by; the season runs May through September, over about six hours.

gem:solden.text: Solden is an alpine ski town in Austria, ringed by the Otztal peaks. Wildspitze and the Rettenbachferner glacier form the core of a visit, with Rifflsee lake up the valley; four hours suit June through August.

gem:lech-am-arlberg.text: Lech am Arlberg is a romantic ski village in Austria, set below the Arlberg pass. Zurs and the Valluga peak are the first stop, with Hoher Ifen and Fellhorn rising nearby; four hours is about right, June to August.

gem:gruner-see.text: Gruner See is a quiet alpine lake area in Austria, framed by the Ybbstal range. Erzberg mine and Prabichl make the rounds worthwhile, with Rax and Hochtor a bit further out; the lake looks best June to August, worth about seven hours.

gem:hossegor.text: Hossegor is a small surf village on the coast of France, set around its own lake. Lac d'Hossegor and Plage du Metro are the local draw, with Bayonne Cathedral and Biarritz a short drive away; best kept to May through September, over about three hours.

gem:kalavryta.text: Kalavryta is a small mountain village in Greece. Agia Lavra monastery and Mega Spilaio top a short list, with Lake Doxa and Aroania a short drive off; come in May or June, when three hours is enough.

gem:diros-caves.text: Diros Caves is a cave and coastal area in Greece. Alepotrypa cave and the Apidima cave are the main attractions, with Cranae island just offshore; it takes about four hours, best May, June, July or September.

gem:kourion.text: Kourion is a historic village on the coast of Cyprus, near Limassol. Kolossi Castle and Limassol Salt Lake make for a two hour stop, best in April, May, June or October. Kourion Beach sits close by, though transport options stay thin.

gem:serifos.text: Serifopoula and Panagia Kanala sit near Serifos, a quiet island in Greece. Chora-Agia Kyriaki and Fykiada beach together run about four hours, from May into September. Avlomonas rounds out a visit; getting around depends on limited transport.

gem:alonissos.text: Alonissos is a quiet, nature-focused island in the Sporades, near Skopelos in Greece. Skantzoura and Lalaria beach add up to roughly four hours, May through August at their best. Koukounaries Marina is within reach, though transport stays patchy.

gem:kythira.text: Kythira lies off the southern Peloponnese in Greece, a remote island of quiet beaches. The Temple of Aphrodite and Kato Chora take up about four hours, best across May to September. Sarakiniko Beach finishes the visit, with transport hard to rely on.

gem:kastoria.text: Kastoria is a lake town in northern Greece, built along Lake Orestiada. Six hours goes to the Monastery of Panagia Mavriotissa and Byzantine Museum of Kastoria, best in May, June or September. Dispilio adds another stop, though transport runs thin.

gem:arezzo.text: Arezzo mixes medieval architecture with a history as an Etruscan settlement, in Tuscany, Italy. Ten hours covers the Duomo di Arezzo and Badia delle Sante Flora e Lucilla, best May, June or September. Public transport here is reliable.

gem:trani.text: Trani is a coastal city in Apulia, Italy, its old town built around the harbor. The Castello svevo di Trani and Cattedrale di San Nicola Pellegrino call for about eight hours, best in May or June. Sinagoga Scolanova adds a nearby stop; transport stays modest.

gem:santa-maria-di-leuca.text: Santa Maria di Leuca marks the southern tip of Apulia, Italy. Two hours suits the Faro di Capo Santa Maria di Leuca and Torre Vado, best in May or June. The New Archaeological Museum of Ugento sits nearby, and transport is thin.

gem:marzamemi.text: Marzamemi is a small coastal town in Italy, known for food and quiet streets. Villa Romana del Tellaro and the Battle of Cape Passaro fill about four hours, best from May to August. Spiaggia Vendicari and Calamosche beach are close; transport is scarce.

gem:inari.text: Inari is a remote lake village in Finland, small enough to see on foot. Siida and Ukonsaari make up the two hours of sights on offer, best in July. Lake Paatari is within reach for a longer stay, though transport runs thin.

gem:studlagil.text: Studlagil Canyon is a dramatic river gorge in Iceland. Hengifoss and Litlanesfoss account for about four hours, best across June to August. Studlafoss and Rjukandi add more waterfalls nearby, with Herdubreid in view and transport scarce.

gem:babia-gora.text: Babia Gora is a small mountain village in Poland, gateway to the national park of the same name. The Church of Saint Clement in Zawoja and Orava together run about three hours, best in July and August. Pilsko rises nearby, though transport runs thin.

gem:soomaa.text: Soomaa National Park is a wilderness area in Estonia, reached along the Halliste river. Raudna river and Tipu village add up to about four hours, best from June to August. Lake Viljandi and Lake Kaisma are within reach for a longer stop, with transport scarce.

gem:alvao-fisgas.text: Alvao is a small town in Portugal, at the edge of its own natural park. Mateus Palace and the Cathedral of Vila Real take up about four hours, best June through August. Serra do Marao and Santuario de Panoias are nearby, though transport stays thin.

gem:vila-franca-islet.text: Vila Franca Islet is a small volcanic island off Sao Miguel in Portugal. The Lighthouse of Ponta Garca and Ilheu de Vila Franca fill six hours, best June through August. Praia do Fogo and Praia da Vinha da Areia are nearby; transport is modest.

gem:zambujeira-do-mar.text: Zambujeira do Mar is a small coastal village in Portugal, part of the municipality of Odemira. The Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina Natural Park and Cabo Sardao Lighthouse make for a two hour stop, best May, June or September. Transport here runs thin.

gem:vila-nova-de-milfontes.text: Vila Nova de Milfontes is a small beach town in Portugal, popular with families. Forte de Milfontes and Pessegueiro Island take about two hours, best May, June or September. Praia do Farol and Milfontes beach round out a stay; transport stays modest.

gem:braganca.text: Braganca is a medieval town in Portugal, its castle rising above the old quarter. The Castle of Braganca and Domus Municipalis take about five hours, best May, June or September. Parque Natural de Montesinho is nearby; transport is thin.

gem:lake-sfanta-ana.text: Lake Sfanta Ana sits among the mountains of Romania, a quiet spot for hiking. Balvanyos Castle and the Dacian fortress of Baile Tusnad take about five hours; June through September suits best. Ciomadul and Harghita Madaras rise nearby; transport is scarce.

gem:breb.text: Breb keeps its traditional village churches in Maramures, Romania. Budesti Josani church and Sarbi Susani church make for about three hours, best from May to September. The Church of the Archangels Michael and Gabriel is also nearby; transport is thin.

gem:cheile-nerei.text: Nera Gorge cuts through the Banat region of Romania, part of a national park of the same name. Pestera cu Oase and the Cheile Nerei-Beusnita National Park fill four hours; May through September works best. Ochiul Beiului lake sits nearby; transport is scarce.

gem:sinemorets.text: Sinemorets is a remote coastal area in Bulgaria, quiet even in summer. The Veleka River Mouth and Silistar take up about four hours, best from May to August. South beach and Silistar beach draw swimmers nearby, though transport is thin.

gem:cuilcagh.text: Cuilcagh Boardwalk is a mountain trail area in the United Kingdom, built for hikers. Cuilcagh and Enniskillen Castle account for about five hours, best across June to August. Lough Erne and Lough Gill are within reach for a longer stay, with transport scarce.

gem:islay.text: Islay lies among the Hebrides off Scotland, an island of scattered villages and coastline. Bowmore Distillery and Finlaggan Castle fill roughly seven hours, best June through August. Beinn an Oir and Claig Castle add more to see, though transport stays modest.

gem:isle-of-arran.text: Isle of Arran sits in the Firth of Clyde off Ayrshire, Scotland. Goat Fell and Lochranza Castle make for a six hour day, best June through August. Holy Island and Caisteal Abhail round things out, though transport stays limited.

gem:glen-affric.text: Glen Affric is a nature area in the United Kingdom, popular for long hikes. Eilean Donan and Carn Eige fill about seven hours; June through August is best. Mam Sodhail, Ben Nevis and Beinn Eighe rise further off; transport is scarce.

gem:mourne-mountains.text: Mourne Mountains rise above County Down in the United Kingdom, near Newcastle. Slieve Donard and Mourne Wall make for a two hour walk, best June to August. Slieve Binnian, Slieve Muck and Slieve Bearnagh fill out the range; transport is thin.

gem:glastonbury.text: Glastonbury is a market town in the English West Country, tied to myths about its hill and abbey. Glastonbury Abbey and Glastonbury Tor take about six hours, best June to September. Wells Cathedral and Chalice Well are also close; transport is thin.

gem:alnwick.text: Alnwick is a market town in Northumberland, northeast England, built around its castle. Alnwick Castle and Alnwick Garden fill about six hours, best June to August. Dunstanburgh Castle and Howick Hall are also nearby, and transport here is reliable.

gem:llyn-peninsula.text: Llyn Peninsula is a quiet coastal area in the United Kingdom, edged by beaches. Bardsey Island and Porth Iago take about six hours, best June to September. Snowdon and Cadair Idris are visible nearby; transport is thin.

gem:gracanica.text: Gracanica Monastery is a small village in Kosovo built around a medieval monastery, a UNESCO site. Prishtina and the National Library of Kosovo make for about three hours, best May, June, July or September. Transport around here is good.

gem:lastovo.text: Lastovo is a remote island in Croatia, quieter than its neighbors. Mrcara and Kopiste together fill about four hours, best May through August. Korcula lies nearby across the water, though transport stays modest.

gem:rab.text: Rab is a medieval island town in Croatia, known within the Kvarner region. Goli otok and Northern Velebit National Park take about five hours, best May to July. Paradise Beach and Ciganka Beach draw visitors nearby; transport is limited.

gem:imotski.text: Imotski is a small town in Croatia, perched above Modro jezero and Red Lake. Biokovo and Sveti Jure make up the core sights, about two hours in May or June. Zubac is also nearby, though transport stays thin.

gem:plav-prokletije.text: Plav is a mountain village in Montenegro, set beside Lake Plav. Jezerce and Zla Kolata together fill about three hours, best from June to August. Gjeravica and Maja e Harapit rise nearby in the Accursed Mountains, transport here scarce.

gem:rijeka-crnojevica.text: Rijeka Crnojevica is a quiet lakeside town in Montenegro. Cetinje Monastery and Lovcen National Park make for about three hours, best May or June. Sveti Stefan and the National Museum of Montenegro are also within reach; transport is thin.

gem:winchcombe.text: Winchcombe is a market town in the Cotswolds, United Kingdom. Sudeley Castle and Gloucester Cathedral together take about four hours, best June through September. Tewkesbury Abbey and Hailes Abbey are also close by, though transport stays thin.

gem:grosseto.text: Grosseto sits in Tuscany, Italy, an old city with a full day of sights to see. Ten hours covers Grosseto Cathedral and the Museo di storia naturale della Maremma, best April, May or September. Public transport here is good.

gem:morpeth.text: Morpeth is a market town in the United Kingdom, anchored by Morpeth Castle. Bothal Castle and Newminster Abbey fill about five hours, best June to August. Belsay Castle and Mitford Old Manor House are also nearby, and transport is reliable.

gem:siofok.text: Siofok sits on the south shore of Lake Balaton in Hungary, better for sightseeing than its beach crowds suggest. Balatonfured and Tihany Abbey top the list, needing about four hours, ideally in May, June or September.

gem:magdeburg.text: Magdeburg mixes cathedral history with art across Saxony-Anhalt, Germany. Ten hours covers the Cathedral of Magdeburg, Kloster Unser Lieben Frauen and the Kulturhistorisches Museum, with May through September the easiest run of months.

gem:landore.text: Liberty Stadium anchors Landore, an area of the United Kingdom that also holds the Gower Peninsula. Oystermouth Castle and St Joseph's Cathedral fill out the rest of seven hours, most rewarding in June, July or August.

gem:poitiers.text: Poitiers combines Futuroscope with a cluster of old churches in France, ten hours of sights if both draw a visit. Eglise Notre-Dame la Grande and Poitiers Cathedral sit close together, and June through September suits it best.

gem:schwabisch-hall.text: Comburg, once a monastery, overlooks Schwabisch Hall in Germany and draws the most visitors of any sight here. Kocher Viaduct and Einkornturm need about six hours between them, best from May through September.

gem:hameenlinna.text: Hame Castle has anchored Hameenlinna in Finland for centuries, still the first stop for most visitors. The Parola Tank Museum and the woods of Aulanko round out nine hours, best from June to August.

gem:dokkum.text: Dokkum in the Netherlands sits right beside the Lauwersmeer, with its national park just outside town. Hantumermolen and Miedenmolen, two windmills, take up most of six hours, best from June through August.

gem:petrovac-na-moru.text: Petrovac na Moru is a beach village on the Montenegro coast, with Sveti Stefan visible along the shore. Two hours is enough for the village itself, though Lovcen rises inland for those staying longer, best May through August.

gem:chalon-sur-saone.text: Chalon-sur-Saone anchors this stretch of France around the moated Chateau de Germolles. Chalon Cathedral and La Ferte Abbey add another few hours, six in total, best from May through September.

gem:simrishamn.text: Simrishamn is a beach village in Sweden, quieter than its coast might suggest. Stenshuvud National Park and The King's Grave are the reasons to stop, four hours worth, though poor transport favors June through August.

gem:badenweiler.text: Badenweiler is a spa village tucked into hills in Germany, its trails better known than its streets. Sausenburg and Aussichtsturm Hochblauen make an easy four hours, best from May to September when paths stay dry.

gem:bechyne.text: A river gorge splits Bechyne, a castle village in Czechia joined together by Bechyne Bridge. Bechyne Castle and Podolsko Bridge fill most of four hours, best from May through September.

gem:abrantes.text: Abrantes rises above the River Tagus in Portugal, its Castle of Abrantes visible for miles. Castle of Almourol sits a short way off, and five hours covers both well, best across April, May or June.

gem:alingsas.text: Alingsas in Sweden is remembered as home to Jonas Alstromer, who first brought the potato here. Anten and Mjorn are the easy day trips, six hours worth, best between June and August.

gem:nietap.text: Nietap is a tiny village in the Netherlands, useful mainly as a base for the Groninger Museum and Drents Museum nearby. Woldzigt and Hoornse Meer round out a quiet four hours, best in June, July or August.

gem:borgholm.text: Borgholm sits on the island of Oland in Sweden, its ruined castle visible for miles across the water. Solliden Palace and Borgholm Church round out three hours there, best from June through August since public transport is poor the rest of the year.

gem:sid.text: Sid is a rural area of Serbia dotted with monasteries, from Petkovica to Kuvezdin and Divsa. The Island of Sarengrad and Privina Glava take the rest of five hours, best across April, May, June or September.

gem:motala.text: Motala grew up as an industrial town on Boren in Sweden, and boats still call here each summer. Vadstena Castle and Vadstena Abbey sit a short trip away, six hours in all, best June through August.

gem:egkomi.text: Egkomi is a coastal town in Cyprus near Othello Castle and the Lala Mustafa Pasha Mosque. St Barnabas Monastery and Ganchvor monastery add another stop, four hours in total, best kept to April or May.

gem:ustron.text: The Vistula rises near Ustron, a mountain resort town in Poland ringed by the Silesian Beskids. Czantoria Wielka, Stozek Wielki and Skrzyczne fill six hours of trails, best walked June through September.

gem:kragujevac.text: Kragujevac sits on the Lepenica River in Serbia, once an industrial center now dotted with monasteries. Sumarice Memorial Park and Divostin Monastery lead seven hours worth of sights, best across April, May, June or September.

gem:pliska.text: Pliska is a small village in Bulgaria built where a medieval capital once stood, centered on Pliska Fortress and the Great Basilica. Tombul Mosque and Shumen Fortress lie nearby in Shumen, and two hours covers the village itself, best in May, June or September.

gem:svilajnac.text: Milkov Monastery is the main stop in Svilajnac, a quiet area of Serbia near Kosmaj mountain, with four hours enough to see it all, best scheduled across April, May, June or September.

gem:viborg.text: Two lakes bound Viborg, a cathedral town in Denmark: Norreso and Tange So. Viborg Cathedral and Viborg Kunsthal make up most of six hours there, with June through August the easiest stretch.

gem:volpedo.text: Volpedo is a small village in Italy, one of the country's officially prettiest borghi. Pieve di San Zaccaria and Pieve di San Pietro are the main stops, three hours worth, best across May, June or September.

gem:pico.text: Pico is a hilltop village in Italy, also named among the country's prettiest borghi. Grotte di Pastena and Monte Appiolo lead a short visit of two hours, best fit into May, June or September.

gem:fortunago.text: Fortunago counts just fifty-one residents, one of the smallest villages on the country's prettiest list. Castello di Montesegale and nearby Montalto Pavese fill three hours easily, best across May, June, July or September.

gem:abbateggio.text: Monte Amaro rises over Abbateggio, a small borgo in Italy and one of the country's officially prettiest villages. Abbazia di San Clemente a Casauria and Castello di Salle make for an easy three hours, best in May, June or September.

gem:montalbano-elicona.text: Castello Federico II crowns Montalbano Elicona, a hilltop village in Italy also listed among the country's prettiest. Abacaenum and the woods of Bosco di Malabotta round out a two-hour visit, best from May through August.

gem:esanatoglia.text: Old churches cluster in Esanatoglia, a small village in Italy counted among the country's prettiest. Concattedrale di Santa Maria Assunta and San Francesco lead a quick two hours there, best in May or June.

gem:zuccarello.text: Zuccarello is a fortified village in Italy near the Toirano Caves, also listed among the country's prettiest. Rocca Barbena and Monte Galero fill out three hours of walking, best across May through September.

gem:pescocostanzo.text: Pescocostanzo is a stone-built village in Italy, one of the country's officially prettiest, home to the Museo del merletto a tombolo. Basilica Santa Maria del Colle anchors three hours there, with Lago di Barrea and Lago di Scanno within reach, best June through August.

gem:alberona.text: Alberona is a small hill village in Italy, one of the country's prettiest borghi. Torre bizantina di Biccari and the forest below Mount Cornacchia fill a two-hour visit, best kept to May or June.

gem:roseto-valfortore.text: Santuario della Madonna del Carmine anchors Roseto Valfortore, another of the country's officially prettiest villages in Italy. Vescellium and, a short trip off, Torre bizantina di Biccari round out two hours, best in May or June.

gem:montefiore-dell-aso.text: Montefiore dell'Aso holds two named theatres, Teatro Vincenzo Pagani and Teatro Luigi Mercantini, in this hill village in Italy. Collegiata di Santa Lucia and Chiesa di Santa Chiara take up the rest of three hours, best from May through August.

gem:neris-les-bains.text: Neris-les-Bains is a spa village in France, one of the country's Plus Beaux Detours. Etablissement thermal and Casino de Neris-les-Bains fill three hours in the village, with the Bourbon dukes castle at Montlucon a short trip further, best June through September.

gem:vernasca.text: Vernasca is a village in Italy scattered with castles, counted among the country's prettiest. Castello di Vigoleno and Rocca Viscontea lead three hours of sightseeing, best across May, June or September.

gem:parfondeval.text: Parfondeval is a fortified village in France, one of the country's Plus Beaux Villages. Eglise Saint-Medard anchors the square, and Bonnefontaine Abbey with the churches of nearby Dohis and Cuiry-les-Iviers fill out three hours, best June through September.

gem:celles-sur-belle.text: Celles-sur-Belle is built around its Abbaye Royale in France, named among the Petites Cites de Caractere. Temple protestant de Beaussais sits close by, and the old churches of Melle add two more hours further off, best across June through September.

gem:benevent-l-abbaye.text: Benevent-l'Abbaye is a village in France recognized as a Petites Cites de Caractere, its Eglise Saint-Barthelemy at the center. Restes du donjon and the Chateau de Montaigut-le-Blanc nearby round out two hours, best across June through September.

gem:bargeme.text: Bargeme is a fortified village in France, among the country's most beautiful. Its ramparts and the churches of Saint-Nicolas and Saint-Laurent take about three hours, with Lac de Castillon close by for a swim. Public transport is thin, June to August is best.

gem:bourg-charente.text: Bourg-Charente is a small riverside village in France, one of the Petites Cites de Caractere. The church of Saint-Leger de Cognac and the Chateau de Bourg-Charente fill most of a three hour stop, best timed for May, June, July or September.

gem:mallievre.text: Mallievre packs a lot into a tiny frame, one of the Petites Cites de Caractere villages in France. Chambretaud and the Chateau du Puy-du-Fou make an easy side trip alongside its own three hours of touring, from June to September.

gem:chenehutte-treves-cunault.text: Chenehutte-Treves-Cunault is a village in France listed among the Petites Cites de Caractere. The Chateau de Boumois and St Florent Abbey account for much of a four hour visit, with Manoir de Grissay adding more nearby, May through September.

gem:chipping-norton.text: Chipping Norton is a market town in the United Kingdom. The Rollright Stones and Chastleton House come first among its sights, with Ascot d'Oilly Castle and Daylesford House filling out roughly three hours, June through September.

gem:bicester.text: Bicester is a market town in the United Kingdom with a long historic core. Middleton Park and Boarstall Duck Decoy head a five hour list of sights, and Hinksey Lake lies close by for a break in the warmer months, June to September.

gem:tadcaster.text: Tadcaster is a market town in the United Kingdom, tied to two decisive battles fought nearby. Marston Moor and the Battle of Towton sit within reach, with Tadcaster Bridge and Grimston Park rounding out three hours, across June, July and August.

gem:lambourn.text: Lambourn is a market town in the United Kingdom. Uffington Castle and Ashdown House come first among its sights, with Seven Barrows and Alfred's Castle nearby, three hours in all, best June through September.
