gem:nagu-archipelago.text: Nagu is a quiet island area in Finland, centered on the Archipelago National Park. Satava, Korpo Church, Sjalo and Storlandet round out the sightseeing, close to five hours best kept for July and August.

gem:levi.text: Levi is a ski area in the mountains of Finland, anchored by Levitunturi. Aakenustunturi, Katkatunturi and Marian kappeli make up the sightseeing, some four hours needed with July the best month.

gem:narva.text: Narva is a fortress city in Estonia, built around Hermann Castle facing Ivangorod Fortress across the water. Narva raekoda and Narva Museum add to the list, nine hours in total, best planned for July or August.

gem:castelo-de-vide.text: Castelo de Vide is a medieval spa village in Portugal, home to the Sinagoga Medieval and its own castle. Portalegre lies close by, adding the Se de Portalegre, Castelo de Portalegre and the Castle of Marvao, three hours all told, best in May.

gem:devils-bridge-ardino.text: Devil's Bridge is a remote mountain village in Bulgaria, named for the Dyavolski most crossing nearby. Ardino, Orlovi Skali, Krivus and Chereshka fill out roughly two hours, best across May, June or September.

gem:baile-herculane.text: Baile Herculane is a spa village in the mountains of Romania, built around the Cerna River. The Neptun bathhouse and the stone bridge over the river make up close to two hours of sights, best in May, June or September.

gem:vama-veche.text: Vama Veche is a beach village on the Black Sea coast of Romania, near the border with Bulgaria. Movile Cave and the Durankulak archaeological complex head the list, with Lake Shabla and Durankulak lake nearby, two hours in total across May through September.

gem:tryavna.text: Tryavna is a fairytale town in the Balkan Mountains of Bulgaria, close to Gabrovo. Daskalov House and the Bacho Kiro cave come first among the sights, with Stoletov and Buzludzha rising nearby, some four hours spread across May, June, July or September.

gem:shaftesbury.text: Shaftesbury sits in Dorset as a market town built around Shaftesbury Abbey. Old Wardour Castle, Stourhead and Clouds House round out close to three hours, best kept for June through August. The Cranborne Chase landscape stretches nearby.

gem:polperro.text: Polperro is a quiet fishing village on the coast of Cornwall. The Eden Project, Restormel Castle and the Lost Gardens of Heligan draw day trips nearby, alongside St Catherine's Castle, filling close to three hours between June and September.

gem:padstow.text: Padstow is a coastal food town in North Cornwall, with Tintagel Castle and Trevose Head opening the sightseeing toward Bedruthan Steps. Booby's Bay and St Issey add the rest, three hours all told, best June through September.

gem:port-isaac.text: Port Isaac is a quiet coastal village in North Cornwall. Tintagel Castle and Bodmin Moor top the list, with Brown Willy and Three Holes Cross further out, close to three hours between June and September. Public transport is poor here.

gem:clovelly.text: Clovelly, in North Devon, gathers around its own Lifeboat Station and Clovelly Court. Hartland Abbey and St Nectan's Church fill in the rest, roughly three hours best kept for June through September.

gem:dunfanaghy.text: Dunfanaghy is a quiet beach village in Ireland, close to Doe Castle and Tory Island. Glenveagh National Park spreads out nearby beneath Muckish and Errigal, close to two hours of sightseeing best kept for June through August.

gem:clonakilty.text: Clonakilty is a beach and food town in Ireland, anchored by the Inchydoney shoreline. Timoleague Abbey, Drombeg stone circle and Ballinacarriga Castle make up some two hours, best between June and August.

gem:prokosko-lake.text: Prokosko Lake is a remote mountain area in Bosnia and Herzegovina, ringed by the peaks of Vranica, Radusa and Bitovnja. Zec Planina rounds out the rest, close to four hours of hiking best kept for July or August.

gem:nin.text: Nin, in Croatia, is home to the Church of St Donatus and the Church of Holy Cross. Ugljan, Vir and Sestrunj sit within view offshore, some two hours of sightseeing across May through August.

gem:konjic.text: Konjic is an adventure town in Bosnia and Herzegovina, set on the Neretva river between Sarajevo and Mostar. Jablanicko Lake and Atomska Ratna Komanda top the list, with Boracko Lake nearby, close to four hours between May and July or in September.

gem:l-aquila.text: L'Aquila, in Italy, gathers around the Basilica of San Bernardino and Forte Spagnolo. Amiternum and the Palazzetto dei Nobili fill in the rest, some six hours to spend in May or June.

gem:northampton.text: Northampton is a market town turned city in the United Kingdom, built around Northampton Cathedral and the Guildhall. The National Lift Tower and Northampton War Memorial add unusual detours, roughly ten hours all told across June through September.

gem:besancon.text: Besancon is a historic city in eastern France, where the Citadel of Besancon faces Besancon Cathedral. The Synagogue of Besancon and the Musee des Beaux-Arts et d'Archeologie make up close to ten hours, best June through September.

gem:chagford.text: Chagford is a historic market town in Devon, on the edge of Dartmoor. Castle Drogo and Gidleigh Castle top the list, with Grey Wethers, Spinsters' Rock and Buckfast Abbey filling close to three hours across June through August.

gem:wetzlar.text: Wetzlar is an art and cathedral city in Germany, gathered around the Dom and the Reichskammergericht. Lottehaus and Jerusalemhaus add to the sightseeing, with Stoppelberg filling out close to ten hours between May and September.

gem:le-mans.text: Le Mans, in France, centers on Le Mans Cathedral and Notre-Dame de la Couture. The Royal abbey of l'Epau adds a quieter stop, with roughly ten hours needed across May through September.

gem:osnabruck.text: Osnabruck grew up around St Peter's Cathedral and the Town Hall in Germany. Felix Nussbaum Haus and Theater Osnabruck add art and stage, with the Heger Tor filling in the rest, nearly ten hours between May and September.

gem:lindlar.text: Lindlar sits in the Bergisches Land region of Germany. Ehreshoven Castle, Schloss Gimborn and Schloss Heiligenhoven top the list, with the Naafbachtal valley filling out close to six hours across June through September.

gem:ruthin.text: Ruthin, in Denbighshire, Wales, gathers around Ruthin Castle and the Ruthin Craft Centre. Rhuddlan Castle and Denbigh Castle sit within reach, some four hours all told between June and August.

gem:landshut.text: Landshut is dominated by Trausnitz Castle above St Martin's Church in Germany. The Hofgarten and Palais Pettenkofer fill in the rest, close to ten hours, best planned across May through September.

gem:messina.text: Messina is a historic city in Italy, gathered around Messina Cathedral and the Fontana di Orione. The Chiesa di Santa Maria Alemanna and the strait of Messina Bridge make up roughly ten hours of sightseeing, best kept for May or June.

gem:southampton.text: Southampton is a historic city in Hampshire, along the south coast of England. The Bargate and God's House Tower top the list, with St Andrew's Castle and The Mayflower filling close to ten hours between June and September.

gem:kardzhali.text: Kardzhali sits in the Eastern Rhodopes of Bulgaria, built around Perperikon. The Womb and Vishegrad fortress add to the list, with the Monastery of John the Precursor filling out some four hours across May, June or September.

gem:fulda.text: Fulda is centered on Fulda Cathedral and Fulda monastery in Germany. St Michael's Church and the Stadtschloss lead further in, with Schloss Fasanerie filling out close to ten hours between June and September.

gem:kielce.text: Kielce is a historic cathedral city in Poland, gathered around the Palace of the Krakow Bishops and the Basilica of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary. Jaskinia Raj and Kadzielnia fill in the rest, roughly ten hours across May through September.

gem:marburg-an-der-lahn.text: Marburg an der Lahn is overlooked by Marburg Castle and St Elisabeth's Church in Germany. The Lahnberge and Bahnhof Marburg station fill out the rest, nearly ten hours between June and September. Colbe station lies nearby too.

gem:ipswich.text: Ipswich is a cathedral city in the United Kingdom, centered on Christchurch Park and Ipswich Town Hall. St Pancras church and Ipswich School add to the list, some ten hours all told across June through September.

gem:treuchtlingen.text: Treuchtlingen lies in the Franconian Jura region of Germany. Wulzburg and the Weissenburg Roman Fort top the list, with Durrenberg and the Fossa Carolina filling out close to six hours between June and September.

gem:vrnjacka-banja.text: Vrnjacka Banja, in Serbia, centers on the Bridge of Love. Ljubostinja Monastery and Sveta Petka Monastery sit further out, with Goc and the Gledic mountains filling out some four hours across May, June, September or October.

gem:castellane.text: Castellane sits in France, gathered beneath Mourre de Chanier. Eglise Saint-Victor de Castellane and Senez Cathedral top the list, with the Pont de l'Artuby filling out close to three hours between May and June or in September.

gem:ploiesti.text: Ploiesti is a cathedral city in Romania, anchored by the Palatul Culturii and Biserica Sfantul Gheorghe Vechi. Ghighiu Monastery and the Ion Luca Caragiale Museum fill in the rest, some nine hours across May and June or in September.

gem:wells-next-the-sea.text: Wells-next-the-Sea is a quiet coastal village in the United Kingdom, home to a little over two thousand people. Holkham Hall tops the sights, with the pilgrimage churches at Walsingham close behind, in about three hours. July and August are the calmer months.

gem:woolacombe.text: Woolacombe is a small surf area on the North Devon coast in the United Kingdom, home to under a thousand people. The Museum of British Surfing tops the list, Bull Point Lighthouse close by, across six hours. June through September suits it best.

gem:flamborough-head.text: Flamborough Head is a quiet coastal village in the United Kingdom, with under two thousand people. Sewerby Hall and Bridlington Priory come first, and RSPB Bempton Cliffs sits a short way off, taking the visit past three hours. July and August suit it best.

gem:elan-valley.text: Elan Valley is a remote lake area of the United Kingdom, set among the Cambrian Mountains with under two thousand people nearby. Craig Goch Dam and Strata Florida Abbey stand out, worth six hours. June to August is the more forgiving window.

gem:applecross.text: Applecross is a remote coastal area in the United Kingdom, ringed by mountains where transport is poor. Eilean Donan and the Isle of Raasay draw the eye first, Scalpay and The Storr filling out five hours. June through August is the easier season.

gem:fowey.text: Fowey is a small coastal town in the United Kingdom, home to around two thousand people on a steep hillside. The Eden Project comes first, St Catherine's Castle and Lostwithiel close behind, across three hours. Best kept to June through September.

gem:salcombe.text: Salcombe is a small coastal town in South Devon, in the United Kingdom, with under two thousand residents. Burgh Island and Dartmouth Castle top the list, near South Milton Sands, in about three hours. June through September suits it best.

gem:hay-on-wye.text: Hay-on-Wye is a small market town in the United Kingdom, set on the edge of Brecon Beacons National Park. Clifford Castle and Hay Bluff lead the sights, with the Black Mountains rising beyond, across six hours. June through August works best.

gem:mizen-head.text: Mizen Head is a remote coastal area in Ireland, at the edge of open water. Fastnet Rock and its lighthouse come first, Dunlough Castle and Lough Hyne close by, across four hours. June through September suits it best.

gem:zrmanja.text: Zrmanja Canyon is a remote natural area in Croatia, with fewer than eight hundred people. Paklenica and the Maslenica Bridge stand out, Vaganski vrh rising above, across four hours. May or June is the better time, since transport is poor.

gem:lake-piva.text: Lake Piva sits in a remote mountain area of Montenegro, with under fifteen hundred people nearby. Durmitor and Bobotov Kuk dominate the views, worth five hours, with Black Lake close by. Best reached between June and August.

gem:apollonia.text: Apollonia is an old Roman city in Albania on the UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List, with a population near fifty six thousand. The Museum of Apollonia and Fier Mosque come first, across six hours. May or June is the best time to see it.

gem:lukomir.text: Lukomir is a remote mountain village in Bosnia and Herzegovina, reached along high slopes near Bjelasnica. Prenj and Visocica rise beyond the village, Boracko Lake close by, across five hours. July and August suit it best, since transport is poor.

gem:borsh.text: Borsh is a quiet beach village in Albania, backed by the Ceraunian Mountains and Mali i Cikes. Porto Palermo Castle and Gjirokaster Fortress come first, Palasa Beach close by, across four hours. May is the best month.

gem:permet.text: Permet is a small spa town in Albania on the Vjosa river, with close to eight thousand residents. Antigonia and the Vjosa Wild River National Park lead the sights, ringed by Mount Nemercke, across two hours. April or May suits it best.

gem:korca.text: Korce is a historic city in Albania, home to about fifty eight thousand people at the foot of Magaro Peak. The National Museum of Medieval Art and Resurrection Cathedral come first, across a full nine hours. May and June bring the best weather.

gem:sremski-karlovci.text: Sremski Karlovci is a small wine town in Serbia on the Danube, with close to nine thousand residents. Petrovaradin Fortress and Varadin Bridge lead the sights, across six hours. April, May, June and September all count as good months.

gem:cosham.text: Cosham is a historic town in the United Kingdom close to Portsmouth, with just over ten thousand people. HMS Victory and the Mary Rose come first, Portchester Castle close by, across six hours. June through September are the best months.

gem:saint-martin-le-vinoux.text: Saint-Martin-le-Vinoux is a small historic village in France near Grenoble, with just over five thousand residents. The Museum of Grenoble and Grenoble Cathedral lead the sights, across four hours. Best anywhere from May through September.

gem:craven-arms.text: Craven Arms is a small market town in the United Kingdom, with just over two thousand residents. Ludlow Castle and Offa's Dyke come first, Stokesay Court close by, across three hours. June through August is the best window.

gem:plymouth.text: Plymouth is a historic city in the United Kingdom on the River Tamar, home to more than a quarter million people. Plymouth Cathedral and Drake's Island come first, across a full ten hours. June through September bring the best weather.

gem:oundle.text: Oundle, a market town in the United Kingdom, holds just under six thousand residents. Fotheringhay Castle and Barnwell Castle lead the sights, across three hours. June through September is the best stretch.

gem:orebro.text: Orebro is a historic city in Sweden, home to nearly one hundred fifty six thousand people. Orebro Castle and Svampen come first, Wadkoping close by, across a full ten hours. June through August bring the best weather.

gem:aosta.text: Aosta is a historic town in Italy, set in a valley below Monte Emilius, with just over thirty five thousand residents. Castello di Saint Pierre and Fenis Castle lead the sights, across six hours. June through September is the best season.

gem:vir.text: Vir is a small beach village in Croatia, with just over three thousand residents on the coast. The Church of St Nicholas anchors the old center, Sestrunj and Molat visible offshore, across two hours. Best kept to May or June.

gem:sambuca-di-sicilia.text: Set in the hills of Italy, Sambuca di Sicilia is one of I Borghi piu belli d'Italia and home to close to six thousand people. Monte Adranone and Lago Arancio come first, across two hours. May and June are the best months.

gem:wellingborough.text: Wellingborough is a historic market town in Northamptonshire, in the United Kingdom, with close to fifty seven thousand people. Finedon Hall and Hinwick House lead the sights, across a full nine hours. June through September are the best months.

gem:biggleswade.text: Biggleswade is a market town in Bedfordshire, in the United Kingdom, with just over sixteen thousand residents. The Shuttleworth Collection and Moggerhanger Park come first, across six hours. June through September are the best months.

gem:szklarska-poreba.text: Szklarska Poreba is a small mountain village in Poland, at the edge of the Giant Mountains, with close to seven thousand residents. Szrenica and Karkonosze National Park lead the sights, across four hours. June through August are the best months.

gem:bonnieux.text: Bonnieux is a small historic village in France, with just over thirteen hundred residents. Senanque Abbey and Chateau de Lacoste come first, Pont Julien close by, across three hours. Best in May, June or September.

gem:neukirchen.text: Neukirchen is a small historic village in Germany near Chemnitz, with just over seven thousand residents. Totenstein and Greifensteine lead the sights, across four hours. Best between June and September.

gem:hagen.text: Hagen is a green city in Germany near where the Ruhr meets other rivers, with close to two hundred thousand residents. Hohensyburg and Schloss Hohenlimburg come first, across a full ten hours. May through September are the best months.

gem:vorden.text: Vorden is a small historic village in the Netherlands, with just under five thousand residents. Kasteel Hackfort and De Wildenborch lead the sights, Villa Bouchina close by, across four hours. Best anywhere from May through September.

gem:protaras.text: Protaras is a beach town in Cyprus, with just over twenty thousand residents along Fig Tree Bay. Agia Napa Monastery and Nissi beach come first, with Paralimni Lake close by, across four hours. Best visited in April or May.

gem:rakvere.text: Rakvere is a historic town in Estonia, with close to fifteen thousand residents. Rakvere Castle and Pandivere Upland lead the sights, near Kadrina Reservoir, across five hours. July and August are the best months.

gem:cassino.text: Cassino is a historic town in Italy, overlooked by the hill of Monte Cassino, with just over twenty one thousand residents. The Abbazia di Montecassino and Aquino Cathedral come first, across five hours. April and May are the best months.

gem:plauen.text: Plauen is a historic city in the Vogtland region of Germany, with close to sixty six thousand residents. The Vogtlandmuseum and Alte Elsterbrucke lead the sights, across a full ten hours. June through September are the best months.

gem:lapithos.text: Lapithos is a small historic village in Cyprus, with close to five thousand residents. Kyrenia Castle and Saint Hilarion Castle come first, Bellapais Abbey close by, across two hours. April, May and June are the best months.

gem:celle.text: Celle is a historic city in Lower Saxony, in Germany, with just over seventy one thousand residents. Celle Castle and the Bomann-Museum lead the sights, across a full ten hours. May through September are the best months.

gem:atienza.text: Atienza is a small historic village in Spain, with just over four hundred residents. The Castle of Atienza and the Church of El Salvador come first, Iglesia de San Gil close by, across three hours. May, June and September are the best months.

gem:oldenburg.text: Oldenburg is a cathedral city in Germany. Schloss Oldenburg and Staatstheater Oldenburg come first, with Lambertikirche and the Lappan tower close by. Ten hours takes in the sights, best May through August.

gem:burghausen.text: A historic town in Germany, Burghausen centers on the long fortress at Burghausen Castle. Raitenhaslach Cistercian Abbey tops the list, alongside a walk by Leitgeringer See or Seeleitensee. Six hours does it, May to September.

gem:vaxjo.text: Vaxjo, a city in Sweden, grew up around cathedral and castle history. Vaxjo Cathedral anchors a walk through town, with Teleborg's Castle and Helgasjon nearby. Ten hours is enough, June through August.

gem:limerick.text: Limerick is a city in Ireland with Georgian streets and a long run of cathedrals. King John's Castle is the highlight, backed by St John's Cathedral and St Mary's Cathedral. The Hunt Museum rounds it out, about eight hours in the city, June through August.

gem:nykoping.text: A castle town in Sweden, Nykoping is known for its grounds. Nykoping Castle and the Sormland Museum headline a visit, and the Femore Coastal Artillery Battery rounds it out toward the coast. Six hours takes in the sights, best June through August.

gem:wei-enburg-in-bayern.text: Weissenburg in Bayern, a town in Germany, sits at the edge of the Franconian Jura. Wulzburg draws the most attention, with the Weissenburg Roman Fort and Grosser Brombachsee in support. Six hours covers the town, best May through September.

gem:recanati.text: Recanati is a town in Italy near the Holy House of Loreto. San Giuliano Church leads, followed by the Church of Santissima Annunziata, with Osimo Cathedral a short trip out toward Macerata, five hours in all. June through August is best.

gem:bad-kreuznach.text: A spa town in Germany, Bad Kreuznach sits on the river Nahe. Ebernburg and Altenbaumburg make the best introduction, with Kloster Rupertsberg close behind and Donnersberg on the skyline. Six hours suits a visit, May through September.

gem:frankfurt-oder.text: Frankfurt (Oder) sits in Germany, a city easy to mix up with its larger namesake. The Wikipedia Monument stands out first, with Kino Piast and the Wohnsiedlung Paulinenhof filling the rest. Ten hours takes in the sights, May through September.

gem:wisla.text: Wisla is a mountain resort town in Poland, set among the Silesian Beskids. Czantoria Wielka opens the visit, with Barania Gora and the Castle of the President of the Republic of Poland following. Six hours suits a first visit, June through August.

gem:sundsvall.text: A hilly city in Sweden, Sundsvall sits on a stretch of coast. Norra berget comes first, with Alnon and the Court of Appeal for Southern Norrland close by. Ten hours does the rounds, best in June or July.

gem:sanok.text: Sanok, a historic town in Poland, lines the San River. Sanok Castle tops the list, alongside the Museum of Folk Architecture, Sobien Castle and the Franciscan Monastery. Six hours start to finish, best May through September.

gem:orleans.text: Orleans, a city in France on the Loire, grew up around its cathedral. Orleans Cathedral anchors the old center, with the Hotel Groslot nearby and Parc Floral de la Source for a longer stay. Ten hours fills the day, May through September.

gem:sandefjord.text: Sandefjord is a city in Norway built on whaling history, named to the UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List. The Southern Actor is the highlight, backed by Gokstadhaugen and Hedrum kirke. June or July works best, nine hours in all.

gem:iserlohn.text: A city in Germany, Iserlohn is known for the Dechen Cave beneath its streets. Altena Castle and Villa Wessel headline a visit, and the Danzturm rounds it out near Harkortsee. Ten hours wraps it up, June through August.

gem:kalisz.text: Kalisz, a cathedral city in Poland, centers on its old quarter. Saint Nicholas Cathedral in Kalisz draws the most attention, with the Church of the Assumption and the Kalisz Town Hall in support, close to nine hours. May through September is best.

gem:kaposvar.text: Kaposvar is a city in Hungary built around the Our Lady of the Assumption Cathedral. Zselicszentjakab Abbey leads, followed by the Adam, Eva-haz and the Gergely Csiky Theatre by Lake Deseda, seven hours in all. May, June and September suit it best.

gem:sassello.text: A small village in Italy, Sassello sits below Monte Beigua with public transport thin on the ground. The Savona Cathedral and Passo del Turchino make the best introduction, with Voltri close behind, four hours, easily. May through July suits it best.

gem:donaueschingen.text: Donaueschingen, a town in Germany, is known for the Magdalenenberg burial mound. Stadtkirche St Johann stands out first, with Schloss Hufingen and the Wutachschlucht gorge filling the rest. Six hours covers the sights, June through August.

gem:arad.text: A historic city in Romania, Arad is not to be confused with the one in Israel. The Fortress of Arad tops the list, alongside Palatul Cultural and the Mures Floodplain Natural Park, the better part of eight hours. April, May, June and September all work well.

gem:eichstatt.text: Eichstatt, a town in Germany, has a baroque center built around its cathedral. Eichstatt Cathedral anchors a walk, with Willibaldsburg and the Residenz Eichstatt nearby. Six hours covers the town, May through September.

gem:arenas-de-san-pedro.text: Arenas de San Pedro is a village in Spain below the Sierra de Gredos. Pico Almanzor is the highlight, backed by La Mira and the Sierra de Gredos Regional Park. Transport here is thin, three hours enough, best April or May.

gem:narbonne.text: Narbonne, a city in France, is built around its cathedral. Narbonne Cathedral and Fontfroide Abbey headline a visit, with the Museum of Archaeology and the Etang de Bages-Sigean for a coastal detour, nine hours in all. May through August suits it best.

gem:barth.text: A small town in Germany, Barth faces the Barther Oie lagoon. The Bibelzentrum Barth draws the most attention, with Kirr and the Gunzer See in support, five hours or so. June through August suits it best.

gem:uddevalla.text: Uddevalla is a quiet town in Sweden split by a river through the center. The Uddevalla Bridge leads, followed by Uddevalla kyrka and Gustafsberg. Skarsjovallen sits further out, six hours or so, June through August.

gem:eskilstuna.text: A city in Sweden, Eskilstuna grew up around its old ironworks quarter. Klosters kyrka and Fors kyrka make the best introduction, with Munktellbadet close behind for a swim. Ten hours is enough here, June through August.

gem:haigerloch.text: Haigerloch, a town in Germany, is stacked below Hohenzollern Castle. The castle stands out first, sharing the ridge with the Kirchberg convent, and Bad Niedernau lies quieter below. Six hours covers the sights, June through September.

gem:cherbourg.text: A port town in France, Cherbourg sits at the tip of the Cotentin Peninsula. The Cite de la Mer opens the visit, with the Basilique Sainte-Trinite and Chateau des Ravalet following, roughly six hours. June through September suits it best.

gem:auch.text: Auch is an old town in France built around its cathedral. Auch Cathedral comes first, with the Museum of the Americas and the Intendance d'Auch close by. Six hours takes care of it, best May, June or September.

gem:kongsberg.text: A small town in Norway, Kongsberg was built on old silver mining wealth. Kongsberg Church tops the list, alongside the Norsk Bergverksmuseum and Lagdalsmuseet, with Jonsknuten on the horizon, five hours in all. June through August suits it best.

gem:norrtalje.text: Norrtalje, a town in Sweden, faces the Stockholm archipelago. Penningby Castle is the highlight, backed by Angso National Park and Frotuna Church. Furusund sits further out on the water, six hours to spare, best July or August.

gem:alcazar-de-san-juan.text: A little town in Spain, Alcazar de San Juan is known for its windmills. The Windmills in Alcazar de San Juan draw the most attention, with those in nearby Campo de Criptana close behind, four hours is plenty. April or May suits it best.

gem:smederevo.text: Smederevo, a fortress city in Serbia, sits on the UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List. Smederevo Fortress dominates the riverfront, with the Church of Holy Trinity in Vranovo close behind. Six hours is enough, best April, May, June, September or October.

gem:cieszyn.text: A town in Poland, Cieszyn is split from its Czech twin by the River Olza. Cieszyn Castle and the Piast tower make the best introduction, with the Museum of Cieszyn Silesia close behind. Czantoria Wielka suits a hike, a good six hours, May through September.

gem:lovech.text: Lovech, a town in Bulgaria, is known for its covered wooden bridge. The Covered Bridge leads, followed by Varosha, Hisarya Fortress and the Lovech Zoo, four hours in all. April, May, June, September and October all work.

gem:kranevo.text: A beach village in Bulgaria near Varna, Kranevo has public transport thin on the ground. The Varna Necropolis stands out first, with the Dormition of the Theotokos Cathedral and Euxinograd close by. Two hours covers the village, best May, June or September.

gem:nunspeet.text: Nunspeet, a lakeside town in the Netherlands, sits between two lakes. Walibi Holland and the Dolfinarium Harderwijk suit a family day, and Cannenburgh Castle rounds it out by the Veluwemeer. Six hours fills the day, June through August.

gem:kraliky.text: A village in Czechia, Kraliky sits below the Kralicky Sneznik ridge, though public transport is thin. Suchy vrch and the Sky Bridge 721 lead, with the Snieznik Mountains and Klepac close by, four hours all told. June through August suits it best.

gem:alexandroupoli.text: Alexandroupoli is a coastal city in Greece in Western Thrace. The Ethnological Museum of Thrace comes first, with the Dimotiki Plaz close by and Traianoupoli a short trip out, five hours in all. May is the best month to come.

gem:boden.text: Boden is a town in Sweden, built up around Boden Fortress. Overlulea kyrka and Boden Garrison round out the sights, with Boden Central railway station worth a look; five hours in all, best from June to July.

gem:balatonalmadi.text: Balatonalmadi is a beach and coast town in Hungary. St Michael's Cathedral and Veszprem Arena sit in nearby Veszprem and Balatonfured; four hours covers the area, best in May, June or September.

gem:nauders.text: Nauders is a small village in Austria near the Reschen Pass, ringed by Piz Mundin, Weisskugel and Fluchthorn. Reschensee and Haidersee sit close by; four hours of sightseeing, best June through August.

gem:harnosand.text: Harnosand is a town in Sweden, built up along the Bothnian coast around Harnosand Cathedral. Hemson and Sabra socken make good half-day trips, and Smitingen draws beachgoers; plan five hours overall, best in July.

gem:spital-am-pyhrn.text: Spital am Pyhrn is a small village in Austria, ringed by Warscheneck, Bosruck and Totes Gebirge. Kalkalpen National Park and Admont Abbey sit within reach, and Gleinkersee and Schiederweiher add a cool stop; four hours suits a visit, best June to August.

gem:buzau.text: Buzau is a city in Romania, anchored by the Communal Palace and the Banului church. Vergu-Manaila House and Crang park round out a full day, with seven hours needed and May or September the best time to go.

gem:kumanovo.text: Kumanovo is a city in North Macedonia, marked by the Church Holy Trinity and the Memorial Ossuary. Zebrnjak and Church St Nicholas add historic layers, while Vodno rises nearby; eight hours covers the sights, best across May, June, September or October.

gem:odder.text: Odder is a town in Denmark, close to Moesgaard Museum and Moesgard Beach. Alro and Tranbjerg make easy side trips, and Stilling-Solbjerg Lake sits below Ejer Bavnehoj; six hours takes in the area, best from June to August.

gem:giglio.text: Giglio is a village in Italy, remembered for the Costa Concordia disaster and for Rocca aldobrandesca. Torre del Saraceno and Torre di Campese overlook the water; two hours covers it, best from June to August.

gem:sadali.text: Sadali is a village in Italy, built around Sa Domu de Orgia and the Chiesa di San Valentino. The Ecomuseums of the Alto Flumendosa and the Chiesa di Sant'Elena fill out a short visit; two hours is enough, best in May or June.

gem:ostana.text: Ostana is a tiny village in Italy below Monviso, with Parco del Monviso and Punta Gastaldi as the main draws. Visolotto and Viso Mozzo add nearby trails, and the Lake of Pontechianale lies close by; three hours suits most visits, best June through September.

gem:zungoli.text: Zungoli is a small village in Italy, centered on the Chiesa di Santa Maria, its only listed sight. Two hours is plenty for the church, and transport here is poor, so plan a car for May or June.

gem:vico-del-gargano.text: Vico del Gargano is a small village in Italy, surrounded by nature reserves like Riserva naturale Falascone and Foresta Umbra. Riserva naturale Sfilzi and the Fontana Sfilzi make for an easy stop, two hours in all, best June through August.

gem:salemi.text: Salemi is a village in Italy, centered on the Chiesa Madre and Monte Polizzo. Montagna di Sale and the Stella d'ingresso al Belice round out the sights, two hours worth, best from June to August.

gem:viggianello.text: Viggianello is a village in Italy on the edge of Pollino National Park. Serra del Prete and Chiesa Santa Caterina lead the sights, with Cappella dell'Assunta close by; two hours covers them, best in May or June.

gem:buonvicino.text: Buonvicino is a village in Italy, built around Castello di San Michele and the Chiesa di San Michele. Montea North peak and Monte La Caccia rise above, and Isola di Cirella lies within view; two hours is enough, best June through August.

gem:aubeterre-sur-dronne-fr.text: Aubeterre-sur-Dronne is a village in France, known for the Eglise monolithe Saint-Jean carved from rock. Chateau d'Aubeterre-sur-Dronne and Eglise Saint-Jacques add more stops, three hours total, best anywhere from May to September.

gem:boston.text: Boston is a market town in the United Kingdom, watched over by Saint Botolph's and the Boston Guildhall. Maud Foster Mill and Sibsey Trader Mill still turn nearby; five hours covers the sights, best from June to September.

gem:horsham.text: Horsham is a city within the United Kingdom that keeps its market town character, centered on Horsham Museum and Chesworth House. Leonardslee and the Unitarian Free Christian Church round things out; nine hours fills a full day, best June through September.

gem:montreuil-bellay-fr.text: Montreuil-Bellay, in France, is a village ruled visually by the Chateau de Montreuil-Bellay above the town. Porte Nouvelle and Eglise Notre-Dame de Montreuil-Bellay fill out three hours, best anywhere from May to September.

gem:vignory.text: Vignory is a village in France, one of the Petites Cites de Caractere, built around the Church of Saint-Etienne and Chateau de Vignory. Eglise Saint-Martin de Doulaincourt lies within reach, two hours total, best June through September.

gem:chailland.text: Chailland is a Petites Cites de Caractere village in France, home to the Menhir dit du Faix du Diable and the Grande Forge. Chateau de Fresnay and the Polissoir dit La Pierre Saint-Guillaume add older layers; two hours in all, best May through September.

gem:thetford.text: Thetford is a market town in the United Kingdom, built near the ruins of Thetford Priory and Thetford Castle. Grime's Graves and Euston Hall sit close by, along with the Charles Burrell Museum; five hours covers it, best June through September.

gem:la-perriere.text: La Perriere is a Petites Cites de Caractere village in France, anchored by Chateau de Monthimer and Chapelle Saint-Santin. Eglise Saint-Nicolas de Mamers and the Salvator church of Belleme extend a visit to three hours, best from June to September.

gem:faymoreau.text: Faymoreau is a small village in France, one of the Petites Cites de Caractere, close to Chateau de la Citardiere and Chateau de Chassenon. Eglise Saint-Etienne and Chateau de Coulonges-sur-l'Autize round out three hours, best from May to September.

gem:le-sap.text: Le Sap is a village in France, part of the Petites Cites de Caractere group, gathered around the eglise Saint-Pierre du Sap and Chateau de Vimer. Dolmen dit la Grosse Pierre lies just outside, three hours in total, best June through September.

gem:montmirail.text: Montmirail is a Petites Cites de Caractere village in France, dominated by the Chateau de Montmirail. Eglise Saint-Martin de Courgenard and Logis de la Pinelliere fill two hours, best from June to September.

gem:fareham.text: Market town Fareham, within the United Kingdom, is tied to naval history through the Mary Rose and the Battle of the Solent. Portchester Castle and Titchfield Abbey lead the sights on land; six hours suits the mix, best June through September.

gem:montsaugeon.text: Montsaugeon is a Petites Cites de Caractere village in France, small enough to see around its own Eglise de Montsaugeon and the Chateau de Cusey. Eglise Saint-Symphorien d'Aubigny lies nearby, two hours enough; June to September is the better run of months.

gem:leominster.text: Leominster is a market town in the United Kingdom, led by Croft Castle and Berrington Hall just outside it. St Cosmas and St Damian's Church anchors the center, with Eye Manor and Lucton School nearby, five hours covers it; June to September is prime time.

gem:daventry.text: Market town Daventry, within the United Kingdom, gathers around Moot Hall and St Peter & St Paul Church. Shuckburgh Hall and St Mary the Virgin Church add further stops, five hours total, best from June to August.

gem:wisbech.text: Wisbech is a market town in the United Kingdom, home to the Wisbech & Fenland Museum and the Clarkson Memorial. Angles Theatre and Leverington Hall extend a visit, five hours worth, best June through September.

gem:wareham.text: Wareham is a small village in the United Kingdom with market town status, close to Corfe Castle and Lulworth Castle. Clavell Tower and the Arne RSPB reserve are within reach too, four hours in all; June through September makes for the mildest visit.

gem:worksop.text: Worksop is a market town in the United Kingdom, ringed by Welbeck Abbey and Worksop Priory. Creswell Crags and Cuckney Castle lie further out, with Worksop Manor besides, six hours covers the ground; June through August works best here.

gem:wantage.text: Market town Wantage, within the United Kingdom, is marked by the King Alfred Statue and the church of Saint Peter and Saint Paul. Seven Barrows and Charney Manor sit outside town, five hours needed; June through September is the season for it.

gem:st-neots.text: St Neots is a market town in the United Kingdom, built up near Eaton Socon Castle and St Denys' Church. All Saints in Little Staughton and the Royal Oak fill out five hours; June to September is the recommended window.

gem:ashby-de-la-zouch.text: Market town Ashby-de-la-Zouch, within the United Kingdom, centers on Ashby de la Zouch Castle and the Church of St Mary and St Hardulph. Calke Abbey and Staunton Harold Hall sit nearby, six hours worth of sights; June through August is the better stretch.

gem:crewkerne.text: Crewkerne is a small village in the United Kingdom with market town status, near manor houses like Hinton House and Wayford Manor House. North Perrott Manor House and the Coke Memorial Methodist Church round out four hours; aim for June to September.

gem:fakenham.text: Walsingham and the Basilica of Our Lady of Walsingham top the list in Fakenham, a market town in the United Kingdom, worth about five hours altogether. Hindringham Meadows and Raynham Hall are also part of the visit, best in July or August.

gem:bedworth.text: Caludon Castle and Astley Castle draw the most attention in Bedworth, a market town in the United Kingdom, over about six hours. Belgrade Theatre, Arbury Hall and Cook Street Gate add to the visit, with June, July and August the best months.

gem:faringdon.text: Kelmscott Manor and Buscot Park head the sights around Faringdon, a village within the United Kingdom, filling roughly three hours. Bampton Castle in Oxfordshire, Great Coxwell Barn and Radcot Bridge are also worth a look, best from June to September.

gem:tenbury-wells.text: St Mary and St John the Baptist are the main sights in Tenbury Wells, a village in the United Kingdom, enough for about three hours. Burford House Garden Store and Eastham Bridge round things out, with June through August the best stretch.

gem:cleobury-mortimer.text: Titterstone Clee and Kinlet Hall lead the way in Cleobury Mortimer, a United Kingdom village, enough to fill three hours. Mawley Hall, Sodington Hall and Saint Mary are nearby, best in June, July or August.

gem:new-milton.text: Christchurch Harbour and Avon Tyrrell face New Milton, a market town in the United Kingdom, taking up about five hours. Burton Common, Lymington River and Highcliffe Castle round things out, with Hurst Spit and Alum Bay Beach, best from June to September.

gem:bingham.text: Sibthorpe and Aslockton come first among the sights near Bingham, a market town in the United Kingdom, spread across about six hours. Lowdham, Wiverton Hall and Rectory Junction Viaduct fill the rest, good from June through September.

gem:lenham.text: Leeds Castle and Sutton Valence Castle overlook Lenham, a village in the United Kingdom, enough sightseeing for three hours. St Mary's Church, The Old House and Charing Windmill are nearby, best June through August.

gem:reutlingen.text: Marienkirche and Schonberg Tower rise above Reutlingen, a city in Germany, with about ten hours needed to see the rest. Spendhaus, Alte Feuerwache and Gartentor complete the list, best from June to September.

gem:recklinghausen.text: Gluckauf-Kampfbahn and Schloss Herten anchor a visit to Recklinghausen, a city in Germany, running to about ten hours. Schloss Bladenhorst and Schloss Berge are also worth seeing, with Baldeneysee and Harkortsee nearby, best May through September.

gem:kopavogur.text: Hallgrimskirkja and the National Museum of Iceland headline Kopavogur, a town in Iceland next to Reykjavik, good for six hours. The Imagine Peace Tower and Landakotskirkja round things out, with Esja rising over Ellidavatn, best June and July.

gem:chiavari.text: San Nicolo and Castello di Punta Pagana top the sights in Chiavari, a town in Italy, taking about six hours. Punta Manara, Museo del Merletto and Chiostro di San Francesco fill the rest, with Baia del Silenzio nearby, best May, June or September.

gem:pietrasanta.text: Villa Medicea di Seravezza and Forte Lorenese anchor Pietrasanta, a town in Italy, enough to fill six hours. Castello Aghinolfi, Badia di San Pietro and Pieve di Santo Stefano are also worth a stop, best from May through August.

gem:hoogeveen.text: De Zwaluw and De Vlijt are the main sights in Hoogeveen, a town in the Netherlands, enough for six hours. Grote Kerk, Narline and Nederlands Hervormde Kerk fill out the rest, best June through August.

OLB.text: The Basilica di San Simplicio and Pittulongu head a visit to Olbia, a coastal city in Sardinia, Italy, known for luxury, spread over about seven hours. The Pozzo sacro di Sa Testa and Castel Pedreso are nearby, best April, May, June or September.

BIA.text: Lucciana Cathedral and Vescovato Cathedral anchor Bastia, an area on the coast of Corsica in France, worth about five hours. San Parteo Church and the etang de Biguglia nature reserve sit close by, under Monte Cinto, best May, June or September.

ORK.text: Blackrock Castle and Saint Fin Barre's Cathedral lead the sights in Cork, a coastal city in Ireland, spread across about nine hours. The Cathedral of St Mary and St Anne, Crawford Art Gallery and Blarney Castle complete the list, best June through August.

gem:vaduz.text: Kunstmuseum Liechtenstein and Vaduz Castle headline Vaduz, a village in Liechtenstein, worth about four hours. Grauspitz and Santis rise over the Appenzell Alps close by, best May through September, though public transport is poor.

gem:holloko.text: Holloko is a village in Hungary preserved as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Cserhat and the Basilica of Our Lady of Assumption lead two hours of sightseeing, with Holloko Castle, Garabi apatsag and Saint Martin Church nearby, best May through September.

gem:nicosia.text: The Cyprus Museum and Church of Cyprus anchor Nicosia, a historic city in Cyprus, enough to fill nine hours. Saint Sophia Cathedral, Famagusta Gate and Buyuk Han are also worth seeing below Stavrovouni Monastery, best in April or May.

gem:hanko.text: The Battle of Hanko and Russaro lead the sights in Hanko, a coastal town in Finland quiet outside summer, worth about four hours. Gustavsvarn, the Russaro Lighthouse and Bengtsar are also nearby, best in July or August, though transport is poor.

gem:kezmarok.text: Kezmarok Castle anchors a visit to Kezmarok, a town in Slovakia with a medieval core, worth about four hours. Stary Smokovec, Tatranska Lomnica and the Evangelic church in Kezmarok are also nearby, good June through August.

gem:celje.text: Ljudska posojilnica leads the sights in Celje, a town in Slovenia with a medieval castle above it, worth about six hours. Zalec, Vojnik, Svetina and Teharje are also nearby, and Lake Smartno sits below Kum, best May through August.

gem:sankt-peter-ording.text: Leuchtturm Westerheversand headlines Sankt Peter-Ording, a coastal village in Germany known for surfing, worth about three hours. Rungholt, Westerheversand, Blauort and Tertius are also nearby, best June through August, though transport is poor.

gem:liechtensteinklamm.text: St Johann im Pongau and Eisriesenwelt lead the sights around Liechtensteinklamm, a quiet village in Austria built around nature and adventure, enough for three hours. Hochkonig rises above Hohenwerfen Castle and Wagrain nearby, June through August is best.

gem:acheron-springs.text: Antipaxos and Pandosia head the list around Acheron Springs, a quiet area in Greece, worth about four hours. The Nekromanteion of Acheron, Cassope and Cichyrus are also nearby, close to Monolithi beach, best in May or June, though transport is poor.

gem:nymfaio.text: Verno and Lake Chimaditida lead the sights around Nymfaio, a village in the mountains of Greece, worth about two hours. Zazari lake, Lake Petron and the Archaeological museum of Florina are also nearby, June through August is best, though transport is poor.

gem:ithaca.text: Cephalonia and Atokos lead the sights around Ithaca, a quiet island in Greece good for hiking, worth about four hours. Arkoudi and the Melissani Cave are also part of the visit, with Myrtos Beach and Porto Katsiki nearby, best May through July.

gem:nuuksio.text: Lake Bodom and the Paijanne Water Tunnel anchor Nuuksio National Park, an area of lakes in Finland, worth about five hours. The Saint Lawrence Church in Lohja, Espoo Cathedral and Finnish Aviation Museum are also part of the visit, best June through August.

gem:hraunfossar.text: Barnafoss and Surtshellir head the sights around Hraunfossar, a quiet area in Iceland, worth about four hours. Ok, Thorisjokull and Prestahnukur are also nearby, above Skorradalsvatn, best in June or July, though transport is limited.

gem:frombork.text: The Archcathedral Basilica of the Assumption leads a visit to Frombork, a coastal village in Poland, worth about three hours. Swiety Kamien and the Muzeum Mikolaja Kopernika we Fromborku are also worth a look, June through August is best.

gem:chelmno.text: Chelmno is a quiet medieval town in Poland. The Teutonic Castle in nearby Swiecie tops the list, followed by Chelmno Landscape Park and the town's own churches, worth about six hours between May and September.

gem:otepaa.text: Otepaa is a village in Estonia, built around skiing and lake life. Otepaa Church and Otepaa Castle sit close together, and Puhajarv makes a fine stop after, all easily covered in three hours from June to August.

gem:kolobrzeg.text: Kolobrzeg is a spa town on the coast of Poland, one of its beach resorts. The Kolobrzeg Lighthouse and the Co-Cathedral Basilica lead a six-hour walk along the shore, best kept to June through August when the beaches fill up.

gem:czestochowa.text: Czestochowa is a historic city in Poland known for baroque churches. Jasna Gora Monastery is the reason most visitors come, and the Cathedral Basilica of the Holy Family adds a second stop; plan around ten hours, best between May and September.

gem:przemysl.text: Przemysl is a fortress city in Poland with a long defensive history. The Cathedral of Przemysl and nearby Krasiczyn Castle lead the sights, worth about ten hours between May and September.

gem:muhu.text: Muhu is a quiet, rural island in Estonia, with Saaretirp beach for a swim. Muhu St Catherine's Church anchors a visit that also takes in Kesselaid and Viirelaid, best done in six hours during July or August.

gem:trancoso.text: Trancoso is a medieval walled town in Portugal, built around its own castle. Castelo de Trancoso comes first, with the nearby Castelo de Moreira de Rei and Castelo de Penedono rounding out a five-hour visit; June, July and September are the best months.

gem:monchique.text: Monchique is a mountain village in Portugal known for its thermal spa. Foia and the Serra de Monchique lead the outing, with Caldas de Monchique for a soak afterward; three hours covers it, June through September.

gem:culross.text: Culross is a small historic village in the United Kingdom, kept for quiet walks rather than crowds. Stirling Castle and Linlithgow Palace make easy day trips nearby, and the Forth Bridge is close as well; four hours here is plenty, June through August.

gem:the-gobbins.text: The Gobbins is a dramatic stretch of coastal path in the United Kingdom. Carrickfergus Castle and Ballygally Castle sit within easy reach along the coast, and the path itself takes about two hours, best walked June through August.
